presets.label: Meta square ad 1:1 (Facebook/Instagram feed, search, Marketplace, carousel)
presets.min_size: at least 1080x1080 on most 1:1 placements; Facebook search 600x600 hard minimum; 3% tolerance (Facebook), 1% (Instagram)
presets.notes: 1:1 is accepted on Facebook Feed, Instagram Feed, Facebook search, Marketplace (recommended there), right column, collection cover and Threads (help 682655495435254). Ads Guide image pages ask for at least 1080x1080; the Facebook feed video spec and the Threads ads help give 1440x1440. Meta asks to keep the bottom and side edges of non-9:16 Instagram Feed ads free of key elements (help 980593475366490) but gives no pixels: the 86 px (6 %) margin is practice, copied from Meta's 9:16 side margin. Text floors assume a full-width 390 px phone feed.

presets.label: Meta carousel ad card 1:1
presets.notes: Facebook Feed carousel: 1:1, 2 to 10 cards, primary text 80, headline 20 and description 18 per card. Instagram Feed carousel: 4:5 when every card is an image (use meta-ad-feed, 1440x1800, per card), 1:1 when any card is a video; primary text 125. Meta may reorder cards for performance unless you turn that off, so every card must stand alone and carry its own offer. Facebook shows cards narrower than the screen so the next one peeks in (width not measured): make card text larger than the 390 px floor. A 1440x1440 master (meta-ad-square) also works.

presets.label: Facebook Marketplace ad 1:1
presets.min_size: Ads Guide: at least 1080x1080; minimum-pixel help: 1200x1200
presets.notes: 1:1 is the recommended ratio (help 682655495435254); 16:9 and 9:16 are also accepted. The minimum-pixel help (469767027114079) says 1200x1200, the Ads Guide says at least 1080x1080: 1200x1200 satisfies both. Primary text 125, headline 40, description 30. Facebook Feed must be selected too, so the feed creative often lands here unless you customise the asset per placement. Shown as a tile in the Marketplace grid: the 190 px view width is an estimate for a two-column grid on a 390 px phone, so keep text to a few large words and let the product fill the frame.

presets.label: Facebook right column ad (desktop)
presets.min_size: Ads Guide: 1:1, at least 1080x1080, hard minimum 254x133; minimum-pixel help: 1200x1200
presets.notes: Still live in 2026, desktop only (placement also in the Marketing API as right_hand_column). Sources disagree on the ratio: the Ads Guide page says 1:1; the aspect-ratio help (682655495435254) marks 1.91:1 as recommended with 1:1 also accepted. This preset uses the 1:1 page value at the minimum-pixel help's 1200x1200; for the 1.91:1 variant render 1200x628. Headline 40. Meta advises no text on the image because the unit shows small; the on-screen width is not published (not measured, needs a logged-in desktop), so view width is left empty. The max_bytes is the 30 MB Ads Guide image limit; the right column page itself lists none. Viewing width 254 px is an estimate of its on-screen size.

presets.label: Meta Reels ad 9:16 with a disclaimer (40 % bottom)
presets.notes: Meta: when a Reels ad carries a disclaimer, leave the bottom 40 % free of text, logos and key elements (40 % of 2560 = 1024 px); top 14 % (358 px) and sides 6 % (86 px) as for every 9:16 ad. The keep-out is the bottom 40 % band. On screens taller than 9:16 Meta may zoom the creative (cropping outside the safe zone) or letterbox it on black. For ads without a disclaimer use meta-ad-story.

presets.label: Ads on Facebook Reels (overlay sticker or banner image)
presets.notes: A small static image laid over someone else's Reel as a banner or sticker. Exact 1:1 (0 % tolerance). Primary text 60, headline 10. The page advises no text on the image because it displays small, so design it as a product or logo shot. On-screen size is not published (view width left empty). Viewing width 120 px is an estimate of its on-screen size.

presets.label: Threads image ad
presets.min_size: no minimum or maximum resolution (Threads ads help); Marketing API: 500 px minimum width
presets.notes: Help: 1.91:1 to 9:16 accepted; images taller than 4:5 are cropped and vertically centred to 4:5; 1440x1440 recommended; primary text 80 to 160 characters (up to 30 hashtags, no URLs), headline 40. No call-to-action button renders, so do not draw one. Mobile only; the ad label now reads Ad, not Sponsored. From September 2026 a Threads-only profile can run ads. View width 318 px is measured: Threads insets media by a 60 px avatar gutter and 12 px right padding (303 px at a 375 px viewport, threads.com, 2026-09-24). 30 MB is the Ads Guide image limit; the Threads page states none.

presets.label: Threads carousel ad card
presets.min_size: 2 to 10 cards, images only; no minimum resolution (help)
presets.notes: Two official Meta pages disagree: the Threads ads help says cards with a ratio outside 4:5 are centre-cropped to 4:5 and recommends 1440x1440; the Marketing API carousel doc says non-square cards are centre-cropped to 1:1. A 1440x1440 card with 144 px side margins survives both crops (a 4:5 crop of 1440 keeps the centre 1152 px). Headline 40 per card; no CTA button renders.

presets.label: Instagram profile picture (circle)
presets.min_size: 320x320 (widely cited); no official size or maximum published
presets.notes: Circle: diameter 320 (the full canvas), centre (160,160); the corners are cut off (21.5 % of the square). Measured 2026-09-24 on instagram.com: 150 px on the desktop profile, 96 px on the phone-web profile; the app profile is about 110 px (widely cited) and feed or story-tray avatars are smaller still. A live story adds a ring around the circle. Instagram publishes no size; 320 is the size guides agree on and the largest variant Meta served for this account on threads.com. Render with --scale 3 for a 960 px master to reuse elsewhere. Copy budget: none, or a 1 to 2 letter monogram.

presets.label: Instagram Story Highlight cover (circle on a 9:16 story)
presets.min_size: none published; the cover is picked from a story frame or the camera roll and cropped in the app
presets.notes: The official help only says to choose a cover; it gives no geometry. The cover editor shows a circle you can pan and zoom. Default assumed here: a circle as wide as the canvas, centred, diameter 1080 at (540,960), so the band y 420 to 1500 matters (estimate). Measured 2026-09-24 on instagram.com desktop: highlights show at 77 px (stored as a 150 px square). The highlight name is live text under the circle: do not repeat it. One bold glyph or icon, thick strokes, one palette across the set.

presets.label: Facebook profile picture (Page or personal, circle)
presets.notes: Circle: diameter 320 px, centre (160,160); safe box = its bounding square inset by 10 %. Official (Pages): displays at 176x176 on computers, 196x196 on smartphones and 36x36 on feature phones; cropped to a circle; 320x320 for best quality; PNG gives better results for logos and text. Measured 2026-09-24: 152 px on the desktop Page header (1440 px viewport) and about 104 px inside its rings on phone web. Personal profiles are assumed to follow the same crop (not documented). The picture also overlaps the bottom-left of the cover (see fb-cover).

presets.label: Threads profile picture (circle)
presets.notes: Circle: diameter 320 px, centre (160,160); safe box = its bounding square inset by 10 %. Circle crop. Measured 2026-09-24 on threads.com (phone web): 64 px on the profile, 36 px beside each post; the largest variant served was 320x320, so a bigger upload gains nothing on screen. Threads has no banner or cover. Hootsuite suggests 640x640; either works.

presets.label: Pinterest square Pin 1:1
presets.min_size: no official minimum for organic images; ad guidelines ask for at least 600 px wide to avoid blur
presets.notes: 1:1 is an official ratio for carousel, collections and video Pins; 1000x1000 is the size guides use for square image Pins. Square is shorter than 2:3, so it is never cut in the feed but takes a third less height. View width 183 px is an estimate for the two-column phone feed ((390 - 3 x 8) / 2); desktop columns are 236 px (Pinterest's Gestalt Masonry default). The home feed adds a faint 4 % black tint over pure white images in light mode (official), so edge-to-edge white reads slightly grey.

presets.label: Pinterest long Pin (taller than 2:3)
presets.min_size: no official maximum ratio for images; guides treat 1:2.1 (1000x2100) as the tallest before a hard crop
presets.notes: Official: Pins with an aspect ratio greater than 2:3 might get cut off in people's feeds. Guides report that Pinterest trims the bottom of taller Pins and that 1:2.1 is the practical limit (postfa.st 2026-06, Recurpost 2026-09). The safe box keeps the hook, logo and call to action in the top 1000x1500 (bottom inset = 2100 - 1500 + 60 = 660), so the Pin still works if only its 2:3 top shows. Put supporting steps below.

presets.label: Pinterest Idea ad 9:16 (full-screen)
presets.min_size: 1080x1920 recommended; no ratio restriction on the media, 9:16 recommended
presets.notes: Official safe zones for Idea ads at 1080x1920: top 270, left 65, right 195, bottom 440, leaving an 820x1210 box. The wide right margin clears the action rail. Title 100 characters, on-page text 250. Video 100 MB on web, 2 GB on mobile. Organic 9:16 Pins use a deeper bottom zone (790): see the pin-9x16 correction.

presets.label: Pinterest carousel card 2:3
presets.notes: Official: 2 to 5 images per carousel, ratio 1:1 or 2:3, PNG or JPEG, 20 MB per image; organic carousels exist too. Use one ratio for every card (practice; the collections page requires it). For square cards render 1000x1000. The first card does the selling in the feed; keep each card to about six words at the ~183 px phone column width.

presets.label: Pinterest collections ad hero
presets.min_size: hero 1:1 or 2:3; all creatives in one ad must share one ratio
presets.notes: Official: one main image above three smaller images, in feeds on mobile devices; tapping opens a full-screen view with up to 24 secondary creatives. The help page says all creatives must share one ratio and recommends 1:1 secondaries: render the hero at 1000x1000 when you follow that strictly. Image files up to 10 MB. The max-width variant spans the full width of the mobile feed (about 374 px, estimate).

presets.label: Pinterest collections ad secondary image
presets.notes: Shown three across under the hero, about 58 px each on a phone (estimate: (183 - 2 x 4) / 3). Use a product on a plain background with no text; the 10 % inset keeps the product clear of the tile's rounded corners.

presets.label: Pinterest board cover (a Pin chosen as cover)
presets.min_size: cannot be uploaded directly: save a Pin to the board, then pick it with the plus icon in Edit board
presets.notes: Official: the board cover is the largest image when viewing the board from your profile, picked from the board's Pins; the separate header image (a featured image at the top of the board) is set only on Android or iOS. Measured 2026-09-24 on pinterest.com: the profile board grid shows the cover as a centred 1:1 tile (176 px, two small tiles beside it); the board page header showed a centred 3:2 crop (540x360). If the same Pin also serves as the header image, keep text within y 167 to 833. Put only the board name, 1 to 4 words.

presets.label: Pinterest profile cover 16:9
presets.min_size: at least 800x450 (official); video covers also allowed
presets.notes: Official: at least 800 px wide and 450 px tall, horizontal 16:9 recommended; you can pan or crop it on upload. Measured 2026-09-24 on desktop pinterest.com: shown at 640x360 beside the profile photo, not under it, so nothing overlaps. The phone layout was not measured: the 390 px view width is an estimate for a full-width phone display. The 5 % inset is practice. 10 MB is widely cited, not official.

presets.label: Pinterest profile picture (circle)
presets.notes: Circle: diameter 280 px, centre (140,140); safe box = its bounding square inset by 10 %. Round avatar. Measured 2026-09-24: 120 px on the desktop profile, served from a 280x280 file, which matches Hootsuite's 280. Pinterest's Gestalt design system says to use round avatars.

presets.label: Snapchat Spotlight 9:16
presets.min_size: video at least 540x960 (Public Profile API); 5 s or longer (app help), 6 to 60 s via the API
presets.notes: Spotlight takes video only, so this canvas is for frames, covers-in-video and text overlays. Snap publishes no organic Spotlight zone; its ads safe-zone article says one spec covers Stories, Spotlight and Commercials: 10 % top (192), 35 % bottom (672), 6 % sides (65), plus a bottom-right notch 15 % wide and 45 % tall for the action rail (keep-out x 918 to 1080, y 1056 to 1920). Snap's recommendation rules demote blurry or low-resolution imagery, wrong orientation, letterboxed or poorly reformatted video, and favour human-made content over wholly AI-generated content made outside Snapchat (values.snap.com recommendation-eligibility quality page).

presets.label: Snapchat Story ad tile (Discover)
presets.min_size: exactly 360x600 (3:5); 8-bit or lower PNG; up to 2 MB
presets.notes: Official: one 360x600 PNG up to 2 MB with a 175 px buffer at the top for the logo; with a CTA, text must also clear a 269 px bottom buffer (headline and CTA), and fit a 300x128 text zone. Keep-outs are those two bands. Headline up to 55 characters (live text, set in Ads Manager). If the tile background is white, Snap suggests a darker gradient towards the bottom so the overlaid headline reads. A tile is required for automatic or Discover placement. The Story behind it holds 1 to 10 Snaps per Ads Manager help (the Ads API says 1 to 20). View width 180 px is an estimate for a two-tile row on a 390 px phone.

presets.label: Snapchat Story ad tile logo
presets.notes: Official: 993 px wide by 284 high, PNG on a transparent background; the artwork should fill the full height, or the full width and at least half the height. Snap lays it over the top 175 px of the tile. 2 MB is the Ads API media limit. No text beyond the brand wordmark. Viewing width 150 px is an estimate of its on-screen size.

presets.label: Snapchat Collection ad thumbnail
presets.min_size: square, at least 160x160 (Business Help; the Ads API says 120x120); 2, 3 or 4 per ad
presets.notes: Official: static JPG or PNG, square only, 2 MB or less each, at least 160x160, and 2, 3 or 4 per ad; each needs its own URL. Snap adds an AD slug at the upper right and the CTA at the upper left of the thumbnail row. Keep the product filling the tile, with little or no text. The 600x600 canvas is our choice for sharpness (about 88 px per tile across a 390 px phone, three device pixels per CSS px), not a Snap number. The main Snap above it follows snap-ad; keep its bottom 450 px free because the thumbnails cover it.

presets.label: Snapchat Public Profile photo (circle)
presets.min_size: at least 320x320; PNG, JPG or JPEG; up to 2 MB
presets.notes: Circle (assumed): diameter 1280 px, centre (640,640); safe box = its bounding square inset by 10 %. Official: minimum 320x320, PNG/JPG/JPEG, maximum 2 MB; display name up to 30 characters. The Public Profile API keeps an original logo 1280 px wide (with 72, 90 and 640 px variants), so a 1280 square is the largest useful upload; keep a photographic JPEG under 2 MB. The circle mask is practice (not documented). On-screen size is not published. Viewing width 110 px is an estimate of its on-screen size.

presets.label: Snapchat Public Profile header image
presets.notes: Official: upload dimensions 375x569, visible dimensions on the profile 375x258, under 2 MB, set in the app or in Ads Manager. Snap does not say which 258 px band shows. The safe box is the overlap of a top-aligned band (y 0 to 258) and a centred band (y 156 to 414), so text survives either reading (estimate). Hootsuite gives 375x278 visible: the official 258 is used. Whether Snap keeps a larger (for example 3x) upload is unverified; treat the header as a photo or pattern with at most a few words.

presets.label: LinkedIn profile photo (circle)
presets.min_size: at least 400x400, at most 7680x4320; no GIF
presets.notes: Circle: diameter 800 px, centre (400,400); safe box = its bounding square inset by 10 %. Official: 400x400 minimum, 7680x4320 maximum, 8 MB, PNG or JPG, GIFs not supported (a549049, a564109). Shown as a circle; members can reposition and zoom after upload. 800x800 is practice. #OpenToWork and #Hiring frames cover the lower part of the circle. LinkedIn's Professional Community Policies require the photo to be your likeness: no logos or illustrations. View width 56 px (comments and search avatars) is an estimate from a third-party guide; the desktop profile header shows it much larger.

presets.label: LinkedIn Page logo (company or Showcase Page)
presets.notes: Official: 400x400 recommended, 268x268 minimum, PNG or JPEG, 3 MB. LinkedIn notes the logo appears on light and dark backgrounds: use an opaque tile, not a dark mark on transparency. Mark only, no tagline. View width 48 px (beside Page posts) is an estimate; at that size an 8 px stroke on the canvas is about 1 CSS px.

presets.label: LinkedIn Career Pages Life tab main image
presets.notes: Official: 1128x376, PNG or JPEG, 3 MB; LinkedIn warns images may be cropped on different screens and to keep key information in the centre. The safe box keeps text in the central two thirds (x 188 to 940), an estimate of that advice. Team photo with 0 to 6 words. View width 390 is an estimate for a phone.

presets.label: LinkedIn Life tab custom module image
presets.notes: Official: 502x282, PNG or JPEG, 3 MB. The page adds its own heading, so keep the image text-free. Company photos in the same tab are 900x600 (minimum 264x176). Viewing width 350 px is an estimate of its on-screen size.

presets.label: LinkedIn newsletter logo
presets.min_size: 300x300 recommended; minimum, maximum and file limit not stated
presets.notes: Official size 300x300. Shape and on-screen size are not documented: the 44 px inset keeps the mark inside the inscribed circle in case it is cropped round (estimate). A monogram with 0 to 2 words. Viewing width 72 px is an estimate of its on-screen size.

presets.label: LinkedIn article or newsletter edition cover 16:9
presets.min_size: 1920x1080 recommended; covers are cropped to 16:9; GIF covers no longer allowed
presets.notes: Official: 1920x1080 for article and newsletter covers (a521719, a517940); covers are cropped to 16:9. The feed-card crop is not documented: the 96 px (5 %) inset would also absorb a 1.91:1 trim of about 37 px top and bottom. The title is live text, so use 0 to 6 words on the image; LinkedIn advises against clip art and generic stock. Article and Newsletter ads reuse single image ad specs. View width 552 is the desktop feed estimate; phones show about 390.

presets.label: LinkedIn carousel ad card 1:1
presets.notes: Official: 1:1 at 1080x1080, card images scaled to 312x312 px on screen, 2 to 10 cards, 10 MB per card, JPG, PNG or non-animated GIF; card headline 45 characters over two lines; intro 150 characters before truncation (255 max); cards cannot be edited after the ad is saved; no video. At 312 px, 14 CSS px text needs about 48 px on the canvas. 3 to 8 words per card.

presets.label: LinkedIn Message and Conversation ad banner
presets.min_size: 300x250 maximum; 40 KB on the Sponsored Messaging help (2 MB on the ad spec pages)
presets.notes: Official: 300x250, desktop only, in the right rail of the Messaging page (not on mobile or chat pop-ups). File limit conflict: 40 KB (a421730) against 2 MB (a425533 Message ads, a426057 Conversation ads): export at 40 KB or less to satisfy both. Conversation ad banners are not clickable, so do not draw a button. Without a banner, other advertisers may fill the slot. Message ads still run in 2026; in the EEA and Switzerland only to members who opted in.

presets.label: LinkedIn ad company logo (Follower, Spotlight, Text ads)
presets.notes: Official marketing pages (undated): 100x100 JPG or PNG, 2 MB, for Follower, Spotlight and Text ads. Mark only.

presets.label: LinkedIn Spotlight ad background
presets.notes: Official marketing page (undated): optional 300x250 JPG or PNG, 2 MB. LinkedIn places the member photo, logo, headline and CTA over or beside it (layout not documented), so keep it a quiet texture with no words.

presets.label: LinkedIn Live stream slate or overlay 16:9
presets.notes: Official encoder settings: 16:9, 720p recommended, 1080p maximum, 30 fps. Render slates and lower thirds at 1280x720 (or 1920x1080 for a 1080p encoder). The 5 % title-safe inset is practice. A Live runs as an Event, so its thumbnail is the event cover (li-event-cover). While a member is live, LinkedIn replaces their profile cover with the stream.

presets.label: LinkedIn group cover 4:1
presets.notes: Official: 1776x444, JPEG or PNG. A third-party guide gives 1536x768: the help page wins. Crop and overlap on screen are not documented; the inset is practice. Viewing width 390 px is an estimate of its on-screen size.

presets.label: YouTube channel profile picture (circle)
presets.min_size: 98x98 render size is the stated minimum; no animated GIF
presets.notes: Circle: diameter 800 px, centre (400,400); safe box = its bounding square inset by 10 %. Official: renders at 98x98, JPG, GIF, BMP or PNG without animation, up to 15 MB. 800x800 is the largest size the Data API serves for channel images and the size YouTube gives for artist avatars. Shown as a circle everywhere (not written in the help). Measured 2026-09-24: 160 px on the desktop channel page (1440 viewport), 72 px on phone web; smaller beside comments and videos. Studio's in-product hint (4 MB) was not fetched: staying under 4 MB satisfies both. One centred mark, no wordmark.

presets.label: YouTube video watermark (branding)
presets.notes: Official: square, at least 150x150, under 1 MB; show it for the last 15 seconds, from a custom start time or for the entire video; not available on made-for-kids videos; set in Studio on a computer. It sits in a corner of the player (bottom right, not written as a spec). Use a one-colour, high-contrast mark on transparency that reads over any footage; render at --scale 2 for a sharper master. Formats: PNG is practice; the help lists none. Viewing width 48 px is an estimate of its on-screen size.

presets.label: YouTube Shorts video frame 9:16
presets.min_size: Shorts up to 1080p upload, up to 3 minutes, square or vertical
presets.notes: For text inside a Short (or a static Short exported as MP4). Google's Shorts ads guidance: avoid the top 10 %, bottom 25 % and right 10 % (192, 480 and 108 px) for the top bar, the channel name, subscribe and caption, and the like, dislike, comment, share and remix rail; the 48 px left margin comes from Google's vertical ad overlay. Applied to organic Shorts as practice: YouTube publishes no organic zone. For anything that may run as a YouTube ad, use Google's stricter overlay window: x 48 to 888, y 288 to 1248, safe [288,192,672,48] (pixel-checked on services.google.com youtubesafezoneoverlay_vertical_final.png, linked from Google Ads help 13547298). Map requests for a 'YouTube story' here: Stories ended on 2023-06-26.

presets.label: YouTube podcast playlist thumbnail 1:1
presets.notes: Official: podcast playlists need a 1:1 thumbnail, 1280x1280 recommended; JPG or PNG; 10 MB from a phone, 50 MB from a computer (answer 72431). For RSS podcasts YouTube builds a still-image video from the show art. One 3000x3000 master (podcast-cover, no alpha for Apple) also works here. Show title in 2 to 6 words. The 80 px inset is practice. Viewing width 160 px is an estimate of its on-screen size.

presets.label: YouTube custom playlist thumbnail 16:9
presets.min_size: no size or file limit published
presets.notes: Custom playlist thumbnails exist since 2024-10-15 (YouTube Blog 'All in the details'): use an image, take a photo or create one with AI. YouTube publishes no size, so this uses the video-thumbnail canvas: playlists sit in 16:9 tiles with a video-count badge (keep-out bottom right, observed). 2 MB keeps phone uploads possible. Podcast playlists use 1:1 instead (yt-podcast-thumb).

presets.label: TikTok profile photo (circle)
presets.notes: Circle: diameter 200 px, centre (100,100); safe box = its bounding square inset by 10 %. Official: photos must be at least 20x20 to upload; a profile video, if set, replaces the photo. 200x200 is the size Hootsuite and Buffer give; render --scale 2 for sharper desktop display. Shown as a circle: 172 px on the desktop web profile (measured 2026-09-24), smaller beside videos. No text; mark only.

presets.label: TikTok Photo Mode slide 9:16
presets.min_size: up to 35 photos per post (official); API images up to 1080p, 20 MB each, JPEG or WebP
presets.notes: Official: up to 35 photos (support page and Content Posting API); API accepts JPEG and WebP, up to 20 MB per image, maximum 1080p; photo titles 90 characters, descriptions 4,000. 9:16 fills the screen (widely cited); 4:5 is said to display well, other ratios are letterboxed on black. The first slide is the cover. The safe box is the organic TikTok UI zone from third-party measurements (same as the tiktok preset): caption and sound bar at the bottom, action rail on the right, tabs at the top. The official Photo Mode help (faq_detail 7581826684085606968) gives the count.

presets.label: TikTok in-feed ad 9:16 (conservative safe zone)
presets.min_size: 9:16 at least 540x960; 1:1 at least 640x640; 16:9 at least 960x540 (official)
presets.notes: TikTok (June 2026): the safe zone depends on the dimension, the ad caption length and any add-ons; the numbers live only in downloadable template files (about 3.9 MB each, standard, Arabic and with-anchor versions) that were not downloaded. Third-party figures range from top 108 to 150, right 100 to 180, bottom 270 to 484 (long captions), left 60. This box takes the conservative set published by CreaMate (https://creamate.ai/en/blog/tiktok-safe-zone-guide, 2026-08): top 140, right 180, bottom 400, left 60; use a 484 bottom for 3 to 4 line captions or interactive add-ons. Spark captions show at most 4 lines; account name 20 characters (10 in CJK); non-Spark captions cannot hold links, @ or hashtags. File limits are for video.

presets.label: TikTok carousel (image) ad card 9:16
presets.min_size: vertical 720x1280 recommended; square 640x640; horizontal 1200x628; 2 to 35 images
presets.notes: Official (September 2026): vertical 720x1280 most recommended, 640x640 and 1200x628 also accepted, JPG or PNG, 2 to 35 images, one caption and one CTA for all, music required, file size of 100 KB or less suggested (max_bytes holds that suggestion; a hard limit was not found). TikTok's playbook warns other ratios may show black bars. The safe box scales the tiktok-ad zone by 0.667 (estimate). Keep one ratio across cards.

presets.label: TikTok ad profile image (non-Spark)
presets.notes: Circle: diameter 98 px, centre (49,49); safe box = TikTok's centred 66x66 key area. Official: 98x98 px, square, JPG or PNG, less than 50 KB; keep the key element in the centre 66x66 px so it is not cropped (shown in a circle). Spark Ads use the creator's own avatar instead. Viewing width 40 px is an estimate of its on-screen size.

presets.label: X profile photo
presets.notes: Circle for most accounts (Verified Organizations get a rounded square): diameter 400 px, centre (200,200); safe box = its bounding square inset by 10 %. Official (X Help, read in a browser 2026-09-24): 400x400 recommended, JPEG, GIF or PNG, 2 MB maximum. Circle for most accounts; Verified Organizations show a rounded square (observed on @NASA). Measured on logged-out x.com: 128 px on the desktop profile (136 px with its border), 78 px on phone web; smaller beside posts (not measured). Mark only.

presets.label: X post portrait 4:5
presets.min_size: images up to 5 MB, GIF up to 15 MB; up to 4 images per post
presets.notes: Files are official (X API docs: JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP; images 5 MB, animated GIF 15 MB; alt text 1,000). Display rule is widely cited (Buffer, Sprout): single images from 2:1 to 3:4 show uncropped in the timeline, so 4:5 shows whole; taller images are centre-cropped (X removed its saliency crop in May 2021). With 2 to 4 images, tiles are cropped: keep text in the centre square. View width 310 px on a 390 px phone is an estimate (media sits right of the avatar column: about 292 px measured at a 375 px viewport, so about 308 at 390); desktop media measured 516 px.

presets.label: X website card or carousel ad 1.91:1
presets.notes: Official (X Ads specs, read in a browser 2026-09-24): 800x418 recommended for 1.91:1 website cards, app cards and image carousels (2 to 6 slides, one ratio per carousel); 5 MB; PNG or JPEG, no BMP or TIFF; GIFs render static. The card headline (70 characters max, 50 to avoid truncation, up to two lines) is drawn on the image 8 to 12 px from its left and bottom edges. The keep-out reserves the bottom 93 px for it (estimate: 12 px inset plus a 24 px label at a 310 px display width). Standalone image ads use 1200x628 or 1200x1200.

presets.label: X website card or carousel ad 1:1
presets.notes: Official: 800x800 recommended for 1:1 website cards and carousels; same headline overlay as x-ad-card, 8 to 12 px from the left and bottom; the 93 px keep-out is an estimate.

presets.label: Bluesky post image
presets.min_size: up to 4 images; the app resizes to at most 4000 px and 2 MB
presets.notes: Official source code: post images up to 2 MB (lexicon raised from 1 MB on 2026-04-08) and 4000 px on the long edge (app, 2026-06-04); up to 4 per post; alt text 2,000 characters. A single image shows at its own ratio up to 1:2 in feeds (taller is cropped); 2 images show as two squares, 4 as a 2x2 grid. The content column is the screen width minus 85 px, so 305 px on a 390 px phone and 515 px in the 600 px web column. Nothing overlays the image; the 5 % margin is practice.

presets.label: Bluesky avatar (circle)
presets.min_size: square crop in the app; capped at 2000 px and 1 MB
presets.notes: Circle: diameter 1000 px, centre (500,500); safe box = its bounding square inset by 10 %. Official: lexicon accepts PNG or JPEG up to 1,000,000 bytes; the app crops 1:1 and compresses to 2000 px and 1 MB. Circle for people, rounded square for feeds and lists. Measured on bsky.app 2026-09-24: 90 px on the profile (desktop and phone), 42 px in the feed per the source code. 1000x1000 is practice.

presets.label: Bluesky profile banner 3:1
presets.min_size: 3:1 crop in the app; capped at 2000 px and 1 MB
presets.notes: Official: lexicon PNG or JPEG up to 1,000,000 bytes; the app crops to 3:1. It always shows 150 px tall at the full column width with a cover fit, so desktop (600x150, 4:1) cuts about 62 px top and bottom and phones (375x150, 2.5:1) cut about 125 px each side: both measured on bsky.app 2026-09-24. The 90 px avatar overlaps the lower left (desktop x 12 to 102, phone x 12 to 102 from the edge, 44 px over the banner); the keep-out is the union of both, from the app's layout code. A back button sits top-left on the web.

presets.label: Mastodon avatar
presets.notes: Circle (in apps; the web shows a rounded square): diameter 400 px, centre (200,200); safe box = its bounding square inset by 10 %. Official docs: up to 2 MB, downscaled to 400x400 (Mastodon 4.4+ servers accept 8 MB, but 2 MB works everywhere); instances can change limits. Web shows a rounded square (80 px on the profile, 46 or 36 px in timelines, measured on mastodon.social 2026-09-24); many apps show a circle, so keep the mark centred. Avatar alt text up to 150 characters (4.6+).

presets.label: Mastodon profile header
presets.min_size: 1500x500 recommended; the server scales to at most 750,000 pixels without cropping
presets.notes: Official: up to 2 MB, 1500x500 (docs); the server keeps the aspect and caps the pixel count, so clients do the cropping. Measured on mastodon.social web 2026-09-24: desktop shows 598x160 (3.74:1, about 50 px cut top and bottom), phone web 375x120 (3.1:1); the 80 px avatar overlaps the lower left by 62 px (keep-out is the union of both layouts). Other apps crop differently: keep text in the centre band.

presets.label: Mastodon post image
presets.min_size: up to 4 images; downscaled to about 8.3 MP (3840x2160); upload limit 16 MB by default
presets.notes: Official docs: up to 4 images per post, downscaled to 8.3 megapixels; the default image limit is 16 MB (instance configuration). Web 4.7 shows a single image at its own ratio, capped at 566 px tall and wide on desktop (so 4:5 shows 453x566); galleries crop to 3:2 or 3:4 tiles around the focal point you set. Alt text up to 10,000 characters on 4.6+ (1,500 before). HEIF is disabled in 4.7.2. View width 356 is an estimate from the 341 px card width measured at a 375 px viewport.

presets.label: Web hero 16:9, HiDPI master (2560 wide)
presets.platform: Any website (WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace, Webflow, Wix, HubSpot)
presets.source: Make WordPress Core, big image handling in 5.3 (2019-10-09), https://make.wordpress.org/core/2019/10/09/introducing-handling-of-big-images-in-wordpress-5-3/; Squarespace Help, Formatting your images for display on the web (updated 2026-06-22), https://support.squarespace.com/hc/en-us/articles/206542517; Webflow Help, Responsive images, https://help.webflow.com/hc/en-us/articles/33961378697107-Responsive-images; StatCounter Global Stats, screen resolution, August 2026, https://gs.statcounter.com/screen-resolution-stats/; MDN, Responsive images (2025-11-06), https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Guides/Responsive_images; web.dev, Optimize LCP (2025-03-31), https://web.dev/articles/optimize-lcp
presets.notes: 2560 is WordPress's big_image_size_threshold (larger uploads are scaled down to 2560) and sits near Squarespace's 2500 px ideal width; Webflow's largest responsive variant is 3200 and HubSpot stops auto-resizing above 4096. Covers a 1280 CSS viewport at 2x or a 1440 CSS viewport at about 1.8x. StatCounter Aug 2026 top desktop widths: 1920 (22.22%), 1536, 1366, 1280. Safe box is derived, not official: it survives a cover crop to 2.4:1 (13% off top and bottom) and to 4:3 (12.5% off each side). Headlines and CTAs belong in HTML over the image; art-direct phones with <picture> (web-hero-mobile or web-hero-mobile-9x16). Never lazy-load the hero; use fetchpriority=high (web.dev).

presets.label: Web section / category banner 3:1
presets.source: Heuristic: the 3:1 family (X header 1500x500, email header 600x200); width kept under the WordPress 2560 threshold. Make WordPress Core, big image handling in 5.3 (2019-10-09), https://make.wordpress.org/core/2019/10/09/introducing-handling-of-big-images-in-wordpress-5-3/
presets.notes: No platform publishes a section-banner size; the height is a design choice. 2400 = 1200 CSS at 2x. Safe top and bottom 100 px survive a cover crop to 4:1 on very wide screens; sides use 5% of the width. At 390 CSS on a phone this banner is only 130 CSS px tall, so any words must be HTML, or supply a separate 4:5 mobile crop.

presets.label: Web hero, mobile art-directed 9:16
presets.source: StatCounter Global Stats, screen resolution, August 2026, https://gs.statcounter.com/screen-resolution-stats/; MDN, Responsive images (2025-11-06), https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Guides/Responsive_images
presets.notes: Use as the <picture> source for narrow viewports (MDN art direction). StatCounter Aug 2026 top phone viewports: 414x896 (13.63%), 360x800, 390x844, 393x873, 384x832, 360x780. A 9:16 image covering a 390x844 viewport keeps about 887 of 1080 px of width, hence 96 px side insets. Top 180 px assumes a 64 CSS px sticky header and bottom 230 px assumes browser toolbars (both heuristic). The existing web-hero-mobile (4:5) is the safer default when the hero is not full screen.

presets.label: Promo strip / announcement bar image (desktop)
presets.source: Heuristic. Shopify and similar themes build announcement bars from text settings; no official image size was found.
presets.notes: Prefer live HTML text (accessible, translatable, no extra download); make an image only for a decorative band. 1200 x 60 CSS at 2x is an assumed size. A desktop strip scaled onto a phone becomes unreadable, so pair it with promo-strip-mobile.

presets.label: Promo strip / announcement bar image (phone)
presets.source: Heuristic, 390 x 60 CSS at 2x; 390 from StatCounter Aug 2026 phone widths. StatCounter Global Stats, screen resolution, August 2026, https://gs.statcounter.com/screen-resolution-stats/
presets.notes: One short line only (about 5 words). Live HTML text is still preferred.

presets.label: Pop-up / modal image, square
presets.platform: Klaviyo, Kit, Mailchimp and similar sign-up forms
presets.source: Kit Help, Recommended image sizes for forms and landing pages (2024-10-09), https://help.kit.com/en/articles/2502556; Klaviyo Help, side images in sign-up forms (2025-09-03) and form styles (2026-01-22), https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/4404257318043; Mailchimp Help, Design a pop-up form, https://mailchimp.com/help/design-popup-form/
presets.confidence: official (size from Kit; weight from Klaviyo)
presets.notes: Kit recommends 1000x1000 for square form images (halving is allowed). Klaviyo: keep form images 600-1000 px wide and under 2000 px tall, aim for 50-100 KB side images; forms with a side image default to 780 px wide, and side images are hidden on mobile by default. Mailchimp recommends about 300 KB for pop-up images. Put the offer and the field labels in the form, not in the picture.

presets.label: Full-page pop-up / form background
presets.source: Klaviyo Help, side images in sign-up forms (2025-09-03) and form styles (2026-01-22), https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/4404257318043
presets.notes: Klaviyo: full-page forms need a larger image, for example a minimum width of 1980 px, and backgrounds under 200 KB. 16:9 at 2000 wide is derived. A background is cropped differently on every screen, so keep it text-free; 10% insets are a heuristic focal-area guide.

presets.label: Blog featured image 3:2 (crop-safe for WordPress themes)
presets.platform: WordPress (default block themes) and most CMS blogs
presets.source: WordPress default themes source (wordpress-develop trunk: twentytwentyfive and twentytwentyfour theme.json and patterns), https://github.com/WordPress/wordpress-develop/tree/trunk/src/wp-content/themes; Make WordPress Core, big image handling in 5.3 (2019-10-09), https://make.wordpress.org/core/2019/10/09/introducing-handling-of-big-images-in-wordpress-5-3/; HubSpot KB, Use a featured image (2026-09-09) and Automatic image resizing (2026-06-30), https://knowledge.hubspot.com/blog/use-a-featured-image-on-a-page-or-blog-post; Webflow Help, Responsive images, https://help.webflow.com/hc/en-us/articles/33961378697107-Responsive-images; Squarespace Help, Formatting your images for display on the web (updated 2026-06-22), https://support.squarespace.com/hc/en-us/articles/206542517
presets.notes: The theme, not WordPress, decides the crop. Twenty Twenty-Five patterns crop featured images to 3:2, 16:9 and 1:1; Twenty Twenty-Four uses 3:2, 3:4 and 4:3; content widths are 645/1340 px (TT5) and 620/1280 px (TT4). The safe box keeps the subject inside both the centre 16:9 band and the centre square; for TT4's 3:4 grids widen the side insets to 600. HubSpot uses the featured image as the social-share thumbnail, so export an og-image (1200x630) crop too. Webflow and Squarespace publish no featured size (Squarespace: 2500 px wide is ideal, under 1500 may blur, keep files under 500 KB). Avoid text on featured images; if unavoidable, respect the text floor.

presets.label: Link preview image, WhatsApp-safe weight
presets.source: Wix Help, Recommended og:image size, https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-recommended-ogimage-size; Meta for Developers, Images in Link Shares, https://developers.facebook.com/docs/sharing/webmasters/images/
presets.confidence: secondary for the 300 KB rule (Wix); official for size (Meta)
presets.notes: Same geometry as og-image, stricter weight: Wix says WhatsApp requires images under 300 KB to show link previews (no WhatsApp page confirmed it). Meta: at least 1200x630, keep close to 1.91:1, minimum 200x200, under 8 MB; images under 600x315 show small.

presets.label: X summary card image 1:1 (small card)
presets.notes: X: 1:1, minimum 144x144, maximum 4096x4096, under 5 MB, cropped to a square on all platforms, only the first GIF frame is used, SVG not supported. The card image shows as a small square, so the 150 CSS viewing width is a heuristic: treat it as text-free (logo or photo only).

presets.label: Favicon 32x32 (ICO/PNG)
presets.source: Evil Martians, How to Favicon in 2026 (updated 2026-01-21), https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/how-to-favicon-in-2021-six-files-that-fit-most-needs; Google Search Central, Define a favicon (updated 2026-08-28), https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/favicon-in-search
presets.notes: Evil Martians 2026: favicon.ico at 32x32 (optionally with 16x16 inside), 32 bpp with alpha, at the site root. Google Search: square, at least 8x8, better larger than 48x48; formats BMP, GIF, ICO, PNG, JPEG, PPM and TIFF. Tabs show it at 16 CSS px, so no words: one letter or a mark.

presets.label: Favicon SVG (vector, dark-mode aware)
presets.source: Evil Martians, How to Favicon in 2026 (updated 2026-01-21), https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/how-to-favicon-in-2021-six-files-that-fit-most-needs
presets.notes: Evil Martians: icon.svg can carry a <style> with @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark); about 72% of browsers support SVG icons, so ship favicon.ico too. The size is a viewBox, not pixels. Needs a vector export path.

presets.label: Apple touch icon 180x180
presets.source: Evil Martians, How to Favicon in 2026 (updated 2026-01-21), https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/how-to-favicon-in-2021-six-files-that-fit-most-needs
presets.notes: Evil Martians: 180x180 PNG; it looks better with about 20 px padding (scale the art to 140x140 on the 180 canvas). The 60 px viewing width assumes 180 = 60 pt at 3x (derived). Use a solid background.

presets.label: Web app manifest icon 192x192
presets.source: Evil Martians, How to Favicon in 2026 (updated 2026-01-21), https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/how-to-favicon-in-2021-six-files-that-fit-most-needs
presets.notes: Manifest icon for the home screen (Evil Martians). The 48 CSS viewing width is a heuristic for launcher size; keep it text-free.

presets.label: Web app manifest icon 512x512
presets.source: Evil Martians, How to Favicon in 2026 (updated 2026-01-21), https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/how-to-favicon-in-2021-six-files-that-fit-most-needs
presets.notes: Used for the splash screen (Evil Martians). Same art as the 192 icon.

presets.label: Maskable icon 512x512 (adaptive)
presets.source: web.dev, Adaptive icon support with maskable icons (2019-12-19), https://web.dev/articles/maskable-icon; Evil Martians, How to Favicon in 2026 (updated 2026-01-21), https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/how-to-favicon-in-2021-six-files-that-fit-most-needs
presets.notes: web.dev: keep important parts inside a centred circle with radius 40% of the icon width (409.6 px across on 512; Evil Martians says 409x409), and the outer 10% may be cropped. The safe box here is the square inside that circle (about 290 px). Fill the whole canvas with the background colour; declare purpose "maskable" separately from "any".

presets.label: App icon master 1024x1024 (iOS, iPadOS, macOS)
presets.notes: Apple HIG: iOS, iPadOS and macOS layout size 1024x1024 px, square, masked to a rounded rectangle; layered icons with default, dark, clear light, clear dark, tinted light and tinted dark appearances built in Icon Composer. tvOS is 800x480 (layered parallax), visionOS 1024x1024 circular, watchOS 1088x1088 circular. The 60 px viewing width is a heuristic; keep icons text-free.

presets.label: Google Play store icon 512x512
presets.source: Google Play Console Help, Add preview assets, https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/9866151
presets.notes: Google Play: 32-bit PNG with alpha, 512x512, maximum 1024 KB (encoded here as 1024 x 1024 bytes). Viewing width is a heuristic.

presets.label: Email hero, Mailchimp new builder (660 CSS at 2x)
presets.source: Mailchimp Help, Image requirements for templates and About template images, https://mailchimp.com/help/image-requirements-for-templates/; Mailchimp Help, Use the content studio, https://mailchimp.com/help/use-the-content-studio/
presets.notes: Mailchimp: use images 660-1320 px wide in the new builder and 600-1200 px in the legacy builder; full-width minimum 660 (new) and 564 (legacy); keep images to 1 MB or less (Content Studio upload limit is 1 MB per image). Klaviyo and Kit templates are 600 px, so email-hero (1200x600) fits them. Classic Outlook for Windows needs an HTML width attribute on the or it shows the file at its natural size (Klaviyo).

presets.label: Email two-column image (300 CSS at 2x)
presets.platform: Klaviyo, Kit, Mailchimp legacy (600 px templates)
presets.source: Klaviyo Help, Optimal email template width reference (2025-08-05), https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/115001435352; Kit Help, Default HTML email templates (2024-10-08), https://help.kit.com/en/articles/2810330; Mailchimp Help, Image requirements for templates and About template images, https://mailchimp.com/help/image-requirements-for-templates/; Klaviyo Help, About email images best practices (2026-02-12), https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005253688
presets.notes: Half of the 600 px default template width (Klaviyo, Kit) at 2x. For Mailchimp's new builder use 660x660 (its 2-column minimum is 330 CSS). If the columns stack on phones (common responsive behaviour, heuristic) the image shows at about 390 CSS, which is still readable. Product names and prices go in HTML.

presets.label: Email hero, animated GIF
presets.source: caniemail.com data, image-gif (last test 2020-02-06), https://github.com/hteumeuleu/caniemail/blob/main/_features/image-gif.md; Klaviyo Help, My email looks different in Outlook (2025-07-07), https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005085387; Klaviyo Help, About email images best practices (2026-02-12), https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005253688; Kit Help, How to add emojis and GIFs to emails (2024-11-07), https://help.kit.com/en/articles/4208912
presets.notes: The first frame must carry the whole message: caniemail shows Outlook for Windows 2007-2016 without GIF animation, and Outlook 2019 with an Office 365 account plays the animation 3 times then stops; Klaviyo says Outlook shows the first frame as a static image. Klaviyo and Mailchimp recommend images of 1 MB or less. Kit recommends at most one GIF per email; Kit and Klaviyo turn animated WebP into a static image.

presets.label: Video thumbnail / poster 16:9 (Vimeo, Wistia, LinkedIn, Loom)
presets.platform: Vimeo, Wistia, LinkedIn video, Loom, Facebook video
presets.source: Vimeo Help, How to change the thumbnail image for my video, https://help.vimeo.com/hc/en-us/articles/12426471350289; Wistia Help, Choose your video's thumbnail, https://support.wistia.com/en/articles/8283897-choose-your-video-s-thumbnail; LinkedIn Marketing Solutions Help, Video ads specifications (updated about 2026-07), https://www.linkedin.com/help/lms/answer/a424737; Atlassian Support, Loom: Add a custom thumbnail, https://support.atlassian.com/loom/docs/add-a-custom-thumbnail/
presets.notes: All three official sources say: match the video's aspect ratio and resolution. Wistia: 1920x1080 (or at least 1280x720) for 16:9, no transparency. Vimeo: exact video dimensions, JPG/GIF/BMP/TIFF/PNG, no animated GIF, at least 80% of pixels near-opaque. LinkedIn video ads: JPG or PNG, 2 MB maximum. Loom custom thumbnails need a Business plan or higher and publish no size. A Facebook video-thumbnail pixel spec was not found. Canva's Twitch guide lists video thumbnails at 1280x720 (same 16:9 ratio). For vertical videos use 1080x1920 with the vertical-safe zone. Safe box is the 5% graphics-safe margin.

presets.label: Lower third, HD (transparent overlay)
presets.source: ITU-R BT.1848-1 (10/2015), Safe areas of wide-screen 16:9 aspect ratio digital productions, https://www.itu.int/rec/R-REC-BT.1848; EBU R 95 v1.1 (June 2017), Safe areas for 16:9 television production, https://tech.ebu.ch/docs/r/r095.pdf; Apple, Final Cut Pro User Guide, Use overlays in the viewer, https://support.apple.com/guide/final-cut-pro/use-overlays-in-the-viewer-verded6d49d7/mac; Netflix Partner Help, English (USA) Timed Text Style Guide (2025-12-19) and General Requirements (2022-10-07), https://partnerhelp.netflixstudios.com/hc/en-us/articles/217350977
presets.notes: ITU-R BT.1848-1 and EBU R 95: graphics safe = 5% in from every edge (96 px sides, 54 px top and bottom at 1920x1080); action safe = 3.5% (67 px sides, 38 px top and bottom). The old 80% title-safe / 90% action-safe convention still ships as the Final Cut Pro overlay; the broadcast standards now use 90/93%. Keep the strip in the lower third but inside graphics safe (bottom edge no lower than y = 1026). The 390 viewing width assumes a landscape video on a phone; on TV-only jobs the DISCAS floor is lower. Netflix subtitle limits are a useful reading-speed check: 42 characters per line, 2 lines, 20 characters per second (adults), 5/6 s to 7 s per event. Export PNG with alpha.

presets.label: Lower third, UHD 4K (transparent overlay)
presets.source: ITU-R BT.1848-1 (10/2015), Safe areas of wide-screen 16:9 aspect ratio digital productions, https://www.itu.int/rec/R-REC-BT.1848; EBU R 95 v1.1 (June 2017), Safe areas for 16:9 television production, https://tech.ebu.ch/docs/r/r095.pdf
presets.notes: ITU-R BT.1848-1 2160p: graphics safe 192 px in at the sides (3456 px wide, 1944 px tall), action safe 134 px (3572 x 2008). Same design as lower-third-1080 at 2x.

presets.label: Title card / full-screen video graphic, HD
presets.source: ITU-R BT.1848-1 (10/2015), Safe areas of wide-screen 16:9 aspect ratio digital productions, https://www.itu.int/rec/R-REC-BT.1848; EBU R 95 v1.1 (June 2017), Safe areas for 16:9 television production, https://tech.ebu.ch/docs/r/r095.pdf; Apple, Final Cut Pro User Guide, Use overlays in the viewer, https://support.apple.com/guide/final-cut-pro/use-overlays-in-the-viewer-verded6d49d7/mac
presets.notes: All text and logos inside graphics safe (5%); essential action inside action safe (3.5%). Hold time: at least the reading time at about 20 characters per second (Netflix adult subtitle rate, used here as a heuristic for on-screen text). YouTube end screens use yt-endscreen.

presets.label: Title card / full-screen video graphic, UHD 4K
presets.source: ITU-R BT.1848-1 (10/2015), Safe areas of wide-screen 16:9 aspect ratio digital productions, https://www.itu.int/rec/R-REC-BT.1848
presets.notes: Same as title-card-1080 at 2x (ITU-R BT.1848-1 2160p figures: graphics safe 3456x1944, action safe 3572x2008).

presets.label: Live-stream overlay (transparent)
presets.source: Canva create pages, Twitch panels and overlays, https://www.canva.com/create/twitch-panels/ and https://www.canva.com/create/twitch-overlays/; Adobe Express, Twitch overlay maker, https://www.adobe.com/express/create/banner/twitch-overlay
presets.notes: Canva: the best size for Twitch overlays is 1920x1080. Adobe Express: 1920x1080 (16:9) for larger webcams and 1600x1200 (4:3) for smaller ones. Leave the centre clear for the content; place the webcam frame and labels inside the 5% graphics-safe margin.

presets.label: Podcast episode art 1:1 (Apple)
presets.source: Apple Podcasts for Creators, Artwork (Show Cover, Episode Art, Full Page Show Art, Showcase Hero, Chapter Art), https://podcasters.apple.com/support/896-artwork-requirements
presets.notes: Apple: 3000x3000 (RSS accepts 1400-3000), PNG or JPG, no transparency or alpha. Apple asks you to avoid your podcast logo or any text in Episode Art, because the episode and podcast titles show beneath it; if no Episode Art is supplied, the Show Cover is used. Chapter Art is also 3000x3000 PNG/JPG, without Show Covers, logos or marketing copy. Use Apple's template for the art safe area.

presets.label: Apple Podcasts Full Page Show Art
presets.source: Apple Podcasts for Creators, Artwork (Show Cover, Episode Art, Full Page Show Art, Showcase Hero, Chapter Art), https://podcasters.apple.com/support/896-artwork-requirements
presets.notes: Apple: 2048x2732, layered PSD, no transparency; shown on the Show Page and in the Player; required when submitting for featuring. Use Apple's template (a ZIP download) for the real safe area; the 5% insets are a placeholder.

presets.label: Meeting virtual background 16:9 (Zoom, Teams, Meet)
presets.source: Zoom Support, Changing your virtual background image (KB0060387), https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0060387; Microsoft Learn, Custom meeting backgrounds for Teams (ms.date 2025-04-30, updated 2026-07-09), https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/custom-meeting-backgrounds; Microsoft Support, Change your background in Teams meetings, https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/change-your-background-in-microsoft-teams-meetings-f77a2381-443a-499d-825e-509a140f4780; Google Meet Help, Change your background, https://support.google.com/meet/answer/10058482
presets.notes: Zoom: 24-bit PNG or JPG, maximum 15 MB, 1280x720 or 1920x1080 for 16:9 cameras (1280x720 minimum when the camera ratio is unknown); video backgrounds MP4/MOV 480x360 to 1920x1080. Teams admin uploads: PNG or JPEG, 360x360 to 3840x2160, up to 50 images (Teams Premium); personal uploads JPG/PNG/BMP. Google Meet: your own view shows the background mirrored, others see it the right way round, so never judge text from self-view. The keep-out (centre half, lower three quarters) is where the person sits: a heuristic. Put logos and words in the upper corners.

presets.label: Slide 16:9 for projection / meeting rooms
presets.platform: PowerPoint, Keynote, Google Slides, Canva, webinars
presets.source: Microsoft Support, Make your PowerPoint presentations accessible, https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/make-your-powerpoint-presentations-accessible-to-people-with-disabilities-6f7772b2-2f33-4bd2-8ca7-dae3b2b3ef25; Microsoft Support, Change the size of your slides, https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/change-the-size-of-your-slides-040a811c-be43-40b9-8d04-0de5ed79987e; Microsoft Learn, Export high-resolution slides (ms.date 2024-06-06), https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office/troubleshoot/powerpoint/change-export-slide-resolution; AVIXA, DISCAS (ANSI/INFOCOMM V202.01:2016) calculator notes, https://www.avixa.org/resources/display-image-size-calculators/learn-more-about-display-size
presets.notes: Microsoft: use 18 pt or larger. PowerPoint's default Widescreen slide is 13.333 x 7.5 in, so 18 pt = 1/30 of the slide height = 36 px on a 1080-high canvas; large_text 48 px = 24 pt, set stricter than WCAG on purpose because projection washes out contrast (heuristic). AVIXA DISCAS cross-check: element height = farthest viewer / 200, e.g. 3.5% of image height (38 px) when the farthest viewer sits 6-7 image heights away. PowerPoint exports 1280x720 at its default 96 dpi, so render the PNG here instead. Use deck-16x9 for decks read on screen.

presets.label: Slide 4:3 (Standard)
presets.platform: PowerPoint Standard, Keynote Standard, Google Slides Standard, Canva
presets.source: Canva size guide, Presentation, https://www.canva.com/sizes/presentation/; Microsoft Support, Change the size of your slides, https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/change-the-size-of-your-slides-040a811c-be43-40b9-8d04-0de5ed79987e; Microsoft Learn, Export high-resolution slides (ms.date 2024-06-06), https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office/troubleshoot/powerpoint/change-export-slide-resolution; Google Docs Editors Help, Change slide size in Google Slides, https://support.google.com/docs/answer/3447672; Microsoft Support, Make your PowerPoint presentations accessible, https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/make-your-powerpoint-presentations-accessible-to-people-with-disabilities-6f7772b2-2f33-4bd2-8ca7-dae3b2b3ef25
presets.notes: Canva's size guide: 4:3 = 1024x768 px. PowerPoint Standard (4:3) is 10 x 7.5 in and exports 960x720 at the default 96 dpi (3000x2250 at 300 dpi). Google Slides offers Standard (4:3), Widescreen (16:9) and Widescreen (16:10) but its help page gives no dimensions. Text floor: 18 pt on a 7.5-in-tall slide = 1/30 of the height = 25.6 px; large = 24 pt. Insets scale deck-16x9's.

presets.label: Slide 16:10
presets.platform: PowerPoint On-screen Show (16:10), Google Slides Widescreen (16:10)
presets.source: Microsoft Support, Change the size of your slides, https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/change-the-size-of-your-slides-040a811c-be43-40b9-8d04-0de5ed79987e; Google Docs Editors Help, Change slide size in Google Slides, https://support.google.com/docs/answer/3447672; Microsoft Support, Make your PowerPoint presentations accessible, https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/make-your-powerpoint-presentations-accessible-to-people-with-disabilities-6f7772b2-2f33-4bd2-8ca7-dae3b2b3ef25
presets.notes: PowerPoint On-screen Show (16:10) is 10 x 6.25 in; Google Slides lists Widescreen (16:10). 1920x1200 is derived. Text floor keeps the 1/30-of-height rule from 18 pt on PowerPoint's 7.5-in slides (40 px); note that 18 pt on the 6.25-in 16:10 preset would be 48 px.

presets.label: A4 landscape deck / handout (true A4)
presets.source: Microsoft Support, Change the size of your slides, https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/change-the-size-of-your-slides-040a811c-be43-40b9-8d04-0de5ed79987e
presets.notes: True A4 is 297 x 210 mm. PowerPoint's "A4 Paper" slide preset is 27.517 x 19.05 cm (10.833 x 7.5 in), not A4, so a PowerPoint A4-preset deck prints with scaling or white bands. No bleed for office printing; add 3 mm bleed if a print shop trims it. Safe 18 mm and text floors copy a4-doc.

presets.label: Twitch profile banner 5:2
presets.source: https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/channel-page-setup (official) + live measurement of twitch.tv/twitch/about at 1440 and 1920 CSS px, 2026-09-24
presets.notes: Twitch recommends 1200x480 and scales the banner to 480 px high. Measured on desktop: it is a cover-scaled background behind a centred offline card plus trailer carousel that hides x 81-1114, y 91-389; on 1920-wide screens the file is scaled 1.4x and the top and bottom 67 px are cut. Treat it as background art: no key text in the middle band. Twitch's own 'concentrate the graphics on the left' advice predates this layout (the left is now under the offline card). Mobile app crop not measured.

presets.label: Twitch offline screen (video player banner) 16:9
presets.source: https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/channel-page-setup (existence, static only); size and 10 MB from https://www.streamscheme.com/twitch-image-sizes/ (secondary, 2026-01-10)
presets.notes: Shown in the player when the channel is offline. Twitch: animated video player banners are not natively supported. Safe box is broadcast title-safe (90%), a practice margin, not a Twitch spec.

presets.label: Twitch info panel (320 wide)
presets.notes: Width is capped at 320 px (larger images are shrunk, so there is no retina gain). Twitch's two pages disagree on the rest: Channel Page Setup says under 2.9 MB and at most 320x300; How to Edit Info Panels says under 1 MB and at most 320x600. Use under 1 MB and 300 px tall or less to satisfy both. Height 160 is a common template size (StreamScheme); Twitch's own channel uses 320x256 and 320x60 panels (measured). Panels sit under the player on desktop.

presets.label: Twitch emote 112 (auto-resizes to 56 and 28)
presets.notes: Upload one square PNG 112x112 to 4096x4096 under 1 MB (auto-resize) or three files 28, 56 and 112 px, each under 512 KB (manual). Transparent background; check it at 100% (28 px in chat). Animated: GIF, max 60 frames, no more than 3 flashes per second. Text needs to be huge or absent.

presets.label: Twitch subscriber badge 72 (also 36 and 18)
presets.notes: Upload three sizes: 18, 36 and 72 px, PNG, transparent, each 25 KB or less. Tier 2/3 badge flair uses the same sizes. Single letters are not allowed unless they are the channel's brand. Shows at 18 px next to names in chat: no text.

presets.label: Kick channel banner
presets.notes: Minimum 1280x700, 4 MB. Shown at the top of the channel page when the stream is offline. Crop and overlays not measured (the test channel was live): safe box is a 5% practice inset.

presets.label: Kick offline banner 16:9
presets.notes: Kick asks for a 1080p image, 1920x1080, 4 MB. Safe box is broadcast title-safe (practice).

presets.label: Discord server banner 16:9
presets.notes: At least 960x540 at 16:9; 1920x1080 is accepted and resized. Needs Boost Level 2 (animated GIF at Level 3: plays 5 s on load, then on hover, never with reduced motion). Discord: keep the top 48 px simple (server name sits there) and avoid logos or text. Shown at the top of the channel list; view width 240 is an estimate of the desktop sidebar, not measured.

presets.label: Discord server invite background
presets.notes: Must be 1920x1080, JPG or PNG, no GIF; Boost Level 1. Discord recommends no logo or text. Measured: the logged-out invite pop-up covers x 720-1200, y 246-834 (the logged-in pop-up is smaller), and the image is drawn with object-fit: fill, so other window shapes stretch it: keep art loose, no circles or faces near the edges.

presets.label: Discord server icon (circle)
presets.source: Widely cited (for example https://www.krumzi.com/size-guide/discord-banner-size); Discord's help does not state a size
presets.notes: 512x512 is the widely cited upload size; Discord masks it to a circle. Animated GIF icons need Boost Level 1 (widely cited). Seen at about 48 px in the server list (estimate): logo only, no words. Safe inset keeps the mark inside the circle.

presets.label: Discord avatar (circle)
presets.notes: Discord lists PNG and GIF (animated GIF avatars need Nitro) and gives no pixel size; 512x512 is common practice. Circle crop; about 40 px beside chat messages (estimate).

presets.label: Discord profile banner (Nitro)
presets.notes: Discord now states a minimum of 680x240 (17:6), under 10 MB, PNG, JPG or animated GIF, Nitro only; the uploader offers a crop. 1360x480 is 2x of that minimum. The avatar circle overlaps the lower left of the banner in profile cards (position not measured: keep that corner quiet). The widely repeated 600x240 is outdated.

presets.label: Discord custom emoji
presets.notes: Under 256 KB; JPEG, PNG, GIF or WEBP; names at least 2 characters. Inline emoji are about 22 px (48 px when sent alone): no text.

presets.label: Discord sticker 320
presets.notes: Exactly 320x320, PNG or APNG, max 512 KB. Renders at 160x160 dp in desktop chat.

presets.label: Reddit community banner (desktop)
presets.notes: Reddit asks for at least 1072x128 on desktop (about 8.4:1); 2144x256 is 2x of that. The old 1920x384 and 4000x192 advice is from earlier layouts. Crop and icon overlap could not be measured (reddit.com is blocked in the test browser): keep the mark centred. Upload a separate mobile banner.

presets.label: Reddit community banner (mobile)
presets.notes: At least 1080x128. Without it Reddit crops the desktop banner (widely reported). Very thin: a name or pattern, nothing more. The older 1600x480 mobile size is outdated.

presets.label: Reddit community icon (circle)
presets.notes: Reddit now says 300x300 (256x256 in older guides). Shown as a circle (widely cited) and often at about 32 px beside posts (estimate): logo only.

presets.label: Reddit image post 4:3 (cross-device)
presets.notes: Reddit's ad spec recommends 4:3 at 1440x1080 as the one image that works across devices and view modes; mobile also takes 1:1 (1080x1080), 3:4 (1080x1440), 4:5 (1080x1350) and 16:9 (1920x1080); other ratios may be letterboxed. 3 MB is the ad limit; organic uploads allow more (20 MB is widely cited, not verified). Organic posts have no published spec: this is the best available guide.

presets.label: Tumblr blog header 16:9
presets.source: https://help.tumblr.com/knowledge-base/appearance-options/ (official) + tumblr.com blog view measured at 390 and 1440 CSS px, 2026-09-24
presets.notes: Tumblr says 2048x1152 (16:9), max 10 MB. Measured: shown uncropped at 16:9 (390x219 on phones, 580x326 on desktop), and when the blog shows its avatar a 96 px avatar overlaps the bottom centre (keepout). The widely cited 3000x1055 is outdated. Custom themes on blogname.tumblr.com may differ.

presets.label: Tumblr avatar
presets.notes: Tumblr's ideal size is 128x128, max 10 MB; GIFs become static. Measured: 96 px square on the blog header (@changes) and a small circle beside posts, so keep the mark inside a centred circle.

presets.label: WhatsApp profile photo (circle)
presets.notes: Cropped to a square with a 640 px maximum edge, max 5 MB (per a WhatsApp Business Platform partner's docs); shown as a circle. WhatsApp's own FAQ gives no size. Chat lists show it at about 56 px (estimate): logo mark only.

presets.label: WhatsApp Business cover photo
presets.notes: WhatsApp confirms the Business app cover photo (public by default, crop and rotate on upload) but publishes no size. 1211x681 (about 16:9) comes from WABetaInfo's testing; other guides say 1920x1080 or 1125x600. Where the profile photo overlaps was not verified: keep the lower left clear.

presets.label: WhatsApp / Meta catalog product image 1:1
presets.notes: Meta catalog rules (these apply when a Meta catalog is linked to WhatsApp Business): JPEG or PNG, 8 MB max, square 1:1, at least 500x500, 1024x1024 recommended, white backdrop preferred. No text over the product, no calls to action, promo codes, watermarks or temporary prices. WhatsApp's in-app catalog publishes no separate size.

presets.label: WhatsApp sticker 512
presets.notes: Exactly 512x512 WebP; static 100 KB max, animated 500 KB max, 10 s max, frames at least 8 ms, and the first frame must show the whole sticker. WhatsApp recommends an 8 px white outline. Tray icon 96x96, 50 KB. 3 to 30 stickers per pack. View width is an estimate.

presets.label: Telegram channel post image 1:1
presets.source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api (sendPhoto limits) + https://core.telegram.org/api/files (photo sizes), official; t.me/s/ preview measured
presets.notes: No official post size. Telegram keeps photos up to 2560 px on the long side (and makes 1280, 800 and 320 versions); bot uploads are capped at 10 MB, width+height 10000, ratio 20. The public preview shows posts about 327 px wide on a 390 px phone (measured). 1:1 at 1280 is a neutral choice; send as a file to avoid recompression.

presets.label: Telegram sticker 512
presets.notes: Static: one side exactly 512 px, the other 512 or less, PNG or WEBP (Telegram tip: transparent background, white stroke, black shadow). Animated .TGS: 512x512 canvas, 3 s max, looped, 64 KB max, 60 fps. Video .WEBM (VP9): one side 512, 3 s, 30 fps, 256 KB max. Set thumbnail 100x100, 128 KB. View width is an estimate.

presets.label: Telegram custom emoji 100
presets.notes: Exactly 100x100. Anyone can make sets; adding and using custom sets needs Telegram Premium. Inline size about 20 px (estimate): no text.

presets.label: Telegram channel avatar (circle)
presets.notes: Telegram generates square crops of 160, 320, 640 and 1280 px; which ones avatars use is not documented, so 640 is a safe master. Shown as a circle, about 54 px in chat lists (estimate): logo only.

presets.label: Viber account / bot icon
presets.notes: Account icon JPEG 720x720, 512 KB max; message sender avatars 720x720 recommended, 100 KB max. Conversation background: JPEG up to 1920x1920, 512 KB.

presets.label: Viber business message image
presets.notes: Partners recommend 800x800 (Infobip; others say 400x400). Official bot API picture messages: JPEG, PNG or static GIF, 1 MB on iOS and 3 MB on Android, so stay under 1 MB. Thumbnails 400x400, 100 KB. Carousel cards 696x600 (Infobip). View width is an estimate.

presets.label: LINE rich menu (large, 2 rows)
presets.notes: OA Manager templates: 2500x1686 or 2500x843 (API also takes 1200x810, 1200x405, 800x540, 800x270). JPEG or PNG, 1 MB max. API rule: width 800-2500, height 250 or more, width/height at least 1.45. One image carries all tap tiles: put each label inside its tile with padding. Not shown on LINE for PC.

presets.label: LINE rich menu (compact, 1 row)
presets.notes: Same rules as the large menu: JPEG or PNG, 1 MB max, tap areas come from the chosen template.

presets.label: LINE rich message 1:1
presets.notes: OA Manager: square 1040x1040, 10 MB max; templates can split it into tap areas. API imagemaps use base width 1040 and must be supplied at 240, 300, 460, 700 and 1040 px wide (JPEG or PNG, 10 MB). Chat bubble width is an estimate.

presets.label: LINE Official Account cover
presets.notes: Account background image: 1080x878 recommended (LINE notes it may vary slightly by viewing environment; translated from Japanese), also shown on the timeline post list. The newer business profile page background is cropped at 2:1 (200x200 minimum, under 10 MB): keep the subject in a centred 2:1 band.

presets.label: LINE Official Account icon
presets.notes: 640x640; the icon can be changed once per hour. Shown as a circle in chat lists (practice); list size is an estimate.

presets.label: LINE sticker (Creators Market)
presets.notes: Sticker images up to 370x320 with even width and height, about 10 px margin, transparent PNG, 1 MB each, 72 dpi or more, RGB; main image 240x240; chat tab 96x74; sets of 8, 16, 24, 32 or 40. Rejected: ads, logos alone, requests for personal data, references to other messaging services, content against public order.

presets.label: KakaoTalk Channel profile
presets.notes: 640x640 recommended, 10 MB, JPG or PNG. The business-channel brand card takes images or video at 16:9, 1:1 or 3:4 (10 MB). List size is an estimate.

presets.label: KakaoTalk channel message image 4:3
presets.notes: Wide-image message: 800x600 (4:3), 10 MB, up to 76 characters of text and an 8-character button. Bubbles take 2:1 to 3:4; anything outside is centre-cropped. Chat width is an estimate.

presets.label: KakaoTalk channel message image 2:1
presets.notes: List-type header 800x400 (2:1; list items 800x800); carousel cards 800x400 or 800x600, all cards in one ratio. 10 MB. Chat width is an estimate.

presets.label: WeChat Official Account article cover 2.35:1
presets.source: https://developers.weixin.qq.com/doc/service/api/draftbox/draftmanage/api_draft_add.html and .../material/permanent/api_addmaterial.html (official); 900x383 is the common practice size
presets.notes: Official: news covers are cropped to 2.35:1 and 1:1 from the same uploaded image (the 1:1 crop is used for secondary articles and shares); image posts also allow 16:9 and up to 20 images. Library images 10 MB (bmp, png, jpeg, jpg, gif); images inside the article body jpg/png under 1 MB. 900x383 is used by editors and hundreds of open-source tools, not stated by WeChat. For one image serving both crops keep the title inside the centre 383x383 (x 258-641), or use wechat-cover-combo.

presets.label: WeChat cover combo 900 + 383 square
presets.source: Practice (for example https://github.com/xstongxue/best-skills skills/wechat-article-writer/reference/cover_guide.md); crop behaviour from the official draft API
presets.notes: Left 0-900 is the 2.35:1 cover, right 900-1283 is a 383x383 square for the 1:1 crop; pick the two crop boxes in the editor. Do not let type cross x 900.

presets.label: Weibo profile cover
presets.source: Measured on weibo.com @微博小秘书 (1242x1242 source) and @人民日报 (1125x1125), 1440 and 883 CSS px wide, 2026-09-24
presets.notes: No official size found. Weibo's own account uses a square 1242x1242 cover; desktop web shows it centre-cropped to 16:9 (641x361), so only y 272-970 shows there, with the 100 px avatar over the lower left. The mobile app shows more of the square (not measured).

presets.label: Xiaohongshu (RED) note image 3:4
presets.source: Measured on xiaohongshu.com explore feed at 390 and 1440 CSS px, 2026-09-24; 1242x1660 widely cited
presets.notes: Measured: mobile web requests every feed cover as a 3:4 crop (360x480) in about 188 px cards; desktop shows covers between 4:3 and 3:4, and 26 of 31 were 3:4. So 3:4 wins feed space; taller images are cut to 3:4. The first image is the cover and the title sits below it, not on it: cover text must read at 188 px wide (about 63 px on a 1080 canvas). 1242x1660 is also widely cited. The per-note image limit was not verified.

presets.label: Douyin landscape video cover 16:9
presets.source: Measured on douyin.com/jingxuan (PC featured feed) at 1440 CSS px, 2026-09-24
presets.notes: Douyin differs from TikTok on PC and for landscape video: the featured PC feed shows 16:9 cards (50 of 52 cards were 400x225). Vertical video uses the tiktok preset. Douyin's creator tool also asks for vertical and landscape covers; the exact ratios there were not verified (login required).

presets.label: VK community cover 5:2
presets.source: Measured on vk.com/team (official VK community, 1822x728 source) at 1440 and 390 CSS px, 2026-09-24; 1920x768 widely cited
presets.notes: VK's own community cover is 1822x728 (5:2), matching the widely cited 1920x768. Desktop shows it at about 3:1 anchored to the bottom, so the top ~17% (130 px) is cut; phones show the full 5:2 with the 92 px avatar over the lower left and back and menu buttons in the top corners. Keepouts: phone avatar, desktop avatar.

presets.label: Google Business Profile cover 16:9
presets.source: https://support.google.com/business/answer/6103862 (official photo rules) + https://www.brightlocal.com/learn/google-business-profile/optimization/google-business-profile-photos/ (secondary, 2025-11-18) + Google Maps place panel measured
presets.notes: Google rules for all profile photos: JPG or PNG, 10 KB to 5 MB, 720x720 recommended, 250x250 minimum, in focus and not heavily edited. Google does not promise the cover shows first and may swap in a customer photo if yours looks low quality. Maps desktop shows the top photo at 426x240 (16:9, measured). 1332x750 is BrightLocal's number.

presets.label: Google Business Profile logo
presets.notes: Uses the general photo rules (720x720 recommended, 250x250 minimum, 10 KB to 5 MB). The logo is highlighted once basic info such as phone and hours is complete. Square with a centred mark; display size is an estimate.

presets.label: Behance project cover
presets.source: https://help.behance.net/hc/en-us/articles/360033998134-Guide-Cover-Images (official) + behance.net gallery measured at 1440 CSS px
presets.notes: At least 808x632 (the 202:158 display ratio at 4x); cropped in the uploader. Measured desktop grid tiles are 330x258 and the CDN serves at most 808 wide, so 808x632 is the useful maximum. GIF is not allowed for covers. Uploads over 50 MB are refused; 10 MB or less recommended.

presets.label: Behance project image (1400 wide)
presets.notes: Behance shows project images at 1400 px wide (narrower ones get side padding) and up to 2800 px in the lightbox: export at 2800 wide for sharpness. Height is free; 1050 is only a 4:3 default. JPEG recommended, RGB (CMYK is converted). Many people view projects on phones, so body text needs about 39 px at 1400 wide.

presets.label: Behance profile banner
presets.notes: Optimal 3200x410, PNG or JPG; you can zoom and reposition on upload. Crop on narrow screens not measured: keep it texture or pattern, not text.

presets.label: Dribbble shot 4:3
presets.source: dribbble.com/shots/popular measured at 1440 CSS px (2026-09-24) + https://developer.dribbble.com/v2/shots/ (official API) + https://help.dribbble.com/en/articles/11056039-dribbble-shot-guidelines (official, 2025-04-08)
presets.notes: Measured: feed thumbnails are 4:3 (297x223 on desktop) and centre-cropped from sources such as 1600x1200. API uploads must be exactly 400x300 or 800x600 and 8 MB max. Rejected: contact details in the shot or description, 'download free icons' and asset-sale shots, ads for services, wholly AI-generated work, unaltered stock, photography.

presets.label: ArtStation project thumbnail 1:1
presets.source: artstation.com explore measured at 1440 CSS px (2026-09-24) + https://help.artstation.com/en/articles/16155253-how-do-i-get-the-best-quality-of-images-on-artstation (official)
presets.notes: Measured: every explore tile is square (about 205 px) and served as an 800x800 'small_square'. Project images must be over 400x400, under 10000x10000 and under 10 MB; ArtStation converts to JPG 90% at 1920 wide (4K when available) and recommends exporting JPG at 3840 px wide in sRGB.

presets.label: ArtStation profile header
presets.notes: Upload over 1920x640 (640 px tall avoids upscaling); a wider file such as 2560x640 gives a thinner header. Resized responsively with the aspect ratio kept; exact crop not measured.

presets.label: Blog featured image, cross-CMS 16:9
presets.platform: WordPress, Medium, Ghost, Substack, Beehiiv, Hashnode
presets.source: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/google-discover (2026-03-09) + WordPress core and Twenty Twenty-Five theme source (trunk, 2026-09-10) + https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408381685268 (2026-03)
presets.notes: Same canvas as article-hero, plus a crop-safe box: WordPress Twenty Twenty-Five shows featured images at 3:2 (x 94-1106 survives), Substack thumbnails at 14:10 (x 128-1072), Open Graph at 1.91:1 (y 24-651). Google Discover wants 1200 px or wider, 16:9, and no logo-only or text-heavy images. For Article structured data also export 1:1 and 4:3 versions.

presets.label: Substack post preview (social image)
presets.notes: At least 1200x630; Substack's preview crop is 14:10, so only the centre 882x630 (x 159-1041) is sure to show. Set Website editor cropping to 'smart' or 'center' if faces get cut. Full-width body images taller than 1:1 are cropped to 1:1.

presets.label: Substack email banner
presets.notes: 1100x220 recommended with a transparent background; can be taller. Logo: at least 256x256, transparent. Cover image: at least 600x600.

presets.label: DEV (dev.to) cover image
presets.source: https://dev.to/p/editor_guide (official) + github.com/forem/forem app/view_objects/cloud_cover_url.rb (source, main branch, checked 2026-09-24)
presets.notes: DEV says the best size is 1000x420; the code crops covers to width 1000 and the site's cover height (default 420). Uploader limit 25 MB.

presets.label: Spotify artist header image
presets.source: https://support.spotify.com/us/artists/article/artist-image-guidelines/ (official) + open.spotify.com artist page measured at 1440 CSS px, 2026-09-24
presets.notes: At least 2660x1140, 20 MB max. No text, advertising or busy backgrounds; no tour or release promotion. Shown on desktop app, web player and TV Now Playing (the mobile app shows the avatar instead). Measured at 1440: box 1150x396, cover-scaled from 15% down, so about 34 px at the top and 191 px at the bottom are lost; the artist name and listener count cover the lower-left band (wider for long names).

presets.label: Spotify artist avatar
presets.notes: Minimum 750x750; 1500 is 2x because the mobile app shows the avatar at the top of the artist profile and in search. No text or ads. Search results show a circle: keep the face central.

presets.label: Music release cover art 1:1
