presets.notes: 3000x3000 RGB passes every store checked: DistroKid (JPG, 1000 minimum, 3000 ideal), TuneCore (square, 1600 to 3000, under 10 MB), Spotify (640 to 10000, sRGB, no upscaling). Apple Music for Artists now says at least 4000x4000; send 4000 only through a distributor that accepts it (TuneCore caps at 3000). Only artist name and exact title as text. Rejected: URLs, QR codes, social handles or logos, store logos, prices, 'CD' or other physical media, blur or pixelation, unlicensed stock, reused art, a parental advisory logo on a non-explicit release.

presets.label: Apple Music artist image
presets.notes: 2400x2400 or larger preferred, 800x800 minimum, no upscaling. Crop so eyebrows and lips sit inside the uploader guides; logos centred on an opaque background. Rejected: borders, text or marketing copy, third-party logos, album covers, QR codes, 'Apple Music' or 'iTunes' wording, pixelation.

presets.label: Apple Music artist logo (iOS 27)
presets.notes: New with iOS 27: a text-based logo matching the artist name, 2880 px wide or 960 px tall, transparent background, filling the template's minimum size area (template not downloaded). Not solid black. No URLs, handles, extra text or album art.

presets.label: Apple Podcasts Showcase Hero 4:1
presets.notes: 4320x1080 layered PSD, no alpha, wide art at the top of the New tab for featured shows. Keep the logo vertically aligned in the template's safe area (template not downloaded; the inset here is practice).

presets.label: SoundCloud profile header
presets.source: https://help.soundcloud.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003450007-Update-Your-Profile-Image-and-Header (official) + soundcloud.com profile measured at 1440 CSS px, 2026-09-24
presets.notes: At least 2480x520, 2 MB max; SoundCloud says avoid text because small screens crop it. Measured on web: shown at 1208x254, anchored left; the 198 px avatar and the name block sit on the left (name box grows with the name), and narrower windows cut the right side (about x 1900 onward). Mobile app crop not measured.

presets.label: SoundCloud track artwork
presets.notes: At least 800x800, under 2 MB. A 3000x3000 album PNG usually breaks the 2 MB cap: export a JPG. Stream tiles are 160 px (measured); profile avatars are circles, track art is square.

presets.label: Bandcamp custom header (desktop)
presets.source: https://get.bandcamp.help/en/articles/15263106-bandcamp-design-tutorial (official, 975 wide) + a live artist page measured, 2026-09-24
presets.notes: Bandcamp's header is 975 px wide; a live page shows 975x180 at 1:1. It is hidden on phones (measured), so repeat the name elsewhere. Album art must be square, at least 1400x1400; background image 1280x1440 recommended.

presets.label: Audiobook cover 1:1
presets.platform: ACX / Audible, Google Play Books, Spotify for Authors
presets.notes: ACX: square, at least 2400x2400, JPG/PNG/TIF, 72 dpi or more, 24-bit RGB, 8 MB max; title and author must be on it. Rejected: blurry text, Audible logos, watermarks, physical media, other stores or websites, running time or price, barcodes or QR codes, book jackets, borders. Exclusive titles may get an 'Only from Audible' triangle 41% in from the bottom-right corner (984 px on 2400): keepout is its bounding box. Google Play: 1:1, ideally 2400x2400 (1024 to 7200 px). Spotify for Authors recommends 3000x3000.

presets.label: Spotify video podcast thumbnail 16:9
presets.notes: Horizontal 16:9, 1920x1080 suggested. Shown only for video episodes, in the Spotify mobile app on show and episode pages and in search. Video episodes: 16:9 recommended, other ratios are letterboxed.

presets.label: Amazon main product image 1:1
presets.background_rule: Pure white RGB 255,255,255. Product fills at least 85% of the frame (measured on the longest side). Only the product that ships: no props, no text, logos, watermarks, borders, insets, colour blocks, badges, placeholders or renders.
presets.notes: Rules official (sell.amazon.com, Amazon style guides). 2000 px is practice: Amazon accepts 500 to 10,000 px on the longest side and needs more than 1,000 px for zoom; its Home programme asks 2,000 px per side. Safe = the 7.5% margin left when the product fills 85%: the product should reach this box, not sit far inside it. Seen first as a search tile: 129 CSS px wide on a 375 px phone (amazon.com mobile web list layout, measured 2026-09-24; sponsored carousels 190 px), then full width (about 375 to 390 px) on the product page. A non-compliant MAIN image can get the ASIN suppressed from search. File-size cap (10 MB) is only secondary-sourced. Apparel: use amazon-apparel.

presets.label: Amazon secondary image 1:1 (infographic, lifestyle, scale, detail)
presets.background_rule: Any background. No promotional text (sale, free shipping), placeholders, watermarks or logo overlays; claims must be accurate.
presets.notes: Up to 9 images per listing (8 alternates + MAIN); Amazon recommends at least 6. Text on secondary images is widely used and not banned in the fetched Amazon material, but Amazon's own A+ guide warns small text is unreadable on phones: design callouts for a 390 px phone view. Safe margin is practice (5%). Same size as the MAIN image keeps the gallery consistent.

presets.label: Amazon Fashion image 10:13
presets.background_rule: Pure white #FFFFFF on MAIN; model standing (no sitting or lying); shoes on except swim and sleepwear; no visible mannequin, hanger or holder; children's underwear and swimwear flat, off-model.
presets.notes: Amazon Fashion style guide sets the site ratio to 10:13 and a 3,900 px cap on the longest side (2022, EU/UK guide; current US wording not verified). 2000x2600 is the ratio at a practical size. Use the same crop across the whole image set.

presets.label: Amazon A+ Basic: image header with text
presets.background_rule: No prices, promotions, shipping, QR codes, links or contact details, 'best-selling' or 'top-rated' claims, warranties or guarantees, competitor comparisons, low-resolution or animated images.
presets.notes: Minimum 970x600 (SP-API); upload at 2x (render --scale 2 = 1940x1200) for sharpness, each image 2 MB or less. Headline 150 and body 6,000 characters live text. Amazon's own guide says do not embed text in A+ images because phones shrink them: keep baked-in words few and large. Basic A+ content column is 970 px wide on desktop and scales to the phone width. Alt text up to 100 characters. Safe margin is practice.

presets.label: Amazon A+ Basic: image and dark/light text overlay
presets.background_rule: No prices, promotions, shipping, QR codes, links or contact details, 'best-selling' or 'top-rated' claims, warranties or guarantees, competitor comparisons, low-resolution or animated images.
presets.notes: Minimum 970x300; KDP recommends 1940x600 (2x). Amazon overlays live text (headline 70, body 300 characters) on a dark or light panel: leave the text side calm. Seen at about 390 px on phones, so the image is about 120 px tall there.

presets.label: Amazon A+ Basic: company logo
presets.background_rule: No prices, promotions, shipping, QR codes, links or contact details, 'best-selling' or 'top-rated' claims, warranties or guarantees, competitor comparisons, low-resolution or animated images.
presets.notes: Minimum 600x180. One brand logo per A+ document (KDP guideline).

presets.label: Amazon A+ Basic: 300x300 module image (three images, single side, highlights, specs, multiple image A)
presets.background_rule: No prices, promotions, shipping, QR codes, links or contact details, 'best-selling' or 'top-rated' claims, warranties or guarantees, competitor comparisons, low-resolution or animated images.
presets.notes: Minimum 300x300 for StandardThreeImageText, SingleSideImage, MultipleImageText, SingleImageHighlights and SingleImageSpecsDetail; KDP recommends 600x600 (render --scale 2). In the three-image module each image is about a third of the column (view width estimate). Avoid words inside these images.

presets.label: Amazon A+ Basic: four image/text tile
presets.background_rule: No prices, promotions, shipping, QR codes, links or contact details, 'best-selling' or 'top-rated' claims, warranties or guarantees, competitor comparisons, low-resolution or animated images.
presets.notes: SP-API prints 'Minimum image size: 220 x 200' (no unit); Jungle Scout lists 220x220. Sources disagree: 220x200 chosen because it is Amazon's own document. Render --scale 2 or larger.

presets.label: Amazon A+ Basic: single image and sidebar (main image)
presets.background_rule: No prices, promotions, shipping, QR codes, links or contact details, 'best-selling' or 'top-rated' claims, warranties or guarantees, competitor comparisons, low-resolution or animated images.
presets.notes: Main image minimum 300x400; the sidebar image is 300x175 minimum. View width is an estimate.

presets.label: Amazon A+ comparison chart product image
presets.background_rule: No prices, promotions, shipping, QR codes, links or contact details, 'best-selling' or 'top-rated' claims, warranties or guarantees, competitor comparisons, low-resolution or animated images.
presets.notes: Minimum 150x300 per product column; up to 6 product columns and 10 metric rows (SP-API model). Compare only your own products: competitor comparisons are rejected. Clean packshots, no words (the chart itself is live text).

presets.label: Amazon Premium A+: full-width image
presets.background_rule: No prices, promotions, shipping, QR codes, links or contact details, 'best-selling' or 'top-rated' claims, warranties or guarantees, competitor comparisons, low-resolution or animated images.
presets.notes: Premium content width is 1464 px (widely cited; Amazon's module-by-module Premium sizes were not verifiable). Premium allows up to 7 modules, video, hotspots and carousels; eligibility is shown in Seller Central. Amazon claims Premium A+ can lift sales up to 20% and Basic up to 8% (Amazon internal data, vendor claim).

presets.label: Amazon Brand Story background
presets.background_rule: No prices, promotions, shipping, QR codes, links or contact details, 'best-selling' or 'top-rated' claims, warranties or guarantees, competitor comparisons, low-resolution or animated images.
presets.notes: Brand Story shows under 'From the brand' on every listing of the brand, up to 19 modules. Background size from SellerApp (not on an Amazon page I could read). Cards scroll horizontally over it: keep the left third calm for the brand logo and headline card.

presets.label: Amazon Brand Story card
presets.background_rule: No prices, promotions, shipping, QR codes, links or contact details, 'best-selling' or 'top-rated' claims, warranties or guarantees, competitor comparisons, low-resolution or animated images.
presets.notes: Amazon's 'Types of A+ Content' sheet gives Brand Story image size 362 x 453. Render --scale 2 for sharpness. View width is an estimate (cards are shown in a horizontal carousel).

presets.label: Amazon Brand Store header (hero)
presets.background_rule: Logo or brand name plus a short tagline; at most 3 products; header copy under 30 characters.
presets.notes: Up to 30% of the width is cropped (15% each side): keep everything inside the centre 2,100 px (Amazon). Amazon's mobile tips ask for text of at least 90 pt (min_text_px set to 90). view_width_px 557 = the whole canvas on a 390 px phone after the side crop (390 x 3000 / 2100). Top and bottom safe margins are practice. 78% of Store visits were on mobile in Q1 2024 (Amazon data).

presets.label: Amazon Store full-width image tile 2:1
presets.background_rule: Text inside images is 'not encouraged' (not read by search engines or screen readers); use Amazon's image-with-text tile for words.
presets.notes: 3,000 px wide recommended for sharp displays; image-with-text and shoppable tiles use 3000x1500. Keepout = the link-title bar Amazon overlays on about 19% of a rectangular tile at the bottom (only when a link title is set). Upload a separate mobile image when a tile carries small text.

presets.label: Amazon Store large square tile
presets.background_rule: Text inside images not encouraged.
presets.notes: Link title covers about 12% of a square tile at the bottom (keepout).

presets.label: Amazon Store medium tile 2:1
presets.background_rule: Text inside images not encouraged.
presets.notes: Link title covers about 19% of a rectangular tile at the bottom (keepout).

presets.label: Amazon Store small square tile
presets.background_rule: Text inside images not encouraged.
presets.notes: Link title covers about 12% of a square tile (keepout). View width assumes two small tiles side by side on a 390 px phone (estimate).

presets.label: Amazon Sponsored Brands custom image 1.91:1
presets.background_rule: Lifestyle scene with the product in use. Not a packshot on a solid or transparent background, not one of the selected product images, no logos, no added text (packaging text is fine), no letterbox or pillarbox bars; ads without a border cannot use a white or off-white background.
presets.notes: Content rules are official (Amazon Ads moderation guide); the 1200x628 size is from third-party guides because Amazon's spec page returned 404. Custom images are required for product-collection ads since 31 Jan 2024 (JumpFly, secondary).

presets.label: Amazon Sponsored Brands / Store logo
presets.background_rule: Logo fills the image or sits on white or transparent; no busy backgrounds, product photos or extra text.
presets.notes: Stores logo at least 400x400 (official). Ads show it at about 60 CSS px (estimate): simple marks only.

presets.label: eBay listing photo 1:1
presets.background_rule: Uncluttered white or neutral background recommended. Policy bans added borders, text, artwork, marketing material and watermarks (including ownership credits); no stock photos for used items.
presets.notes: About 1600x1600 recommended; up to 24 photos; 1:1 or 16:9 look best; the first photo is the search image, shown 120x120 CSS px on a 375 px phone (ebay.com mobile web, measured 2026-09-24; served as a 300 px file). eBay warns badges, logos and watermarks can hurt search placement. Safe margin is practice.

presets.label: eBay Store billboard
presets.background_rule: Brand image; keep words few (mobile shows it about 88 px tall).
presets.notes: 1280 x 290 (eBay help, re-checked; some older guides say 1280x280). Standard or carousel billboard. Mobile crop not documented: keep the message in the centre. Store logo 300x300 and marketing banner 640x640 are separate presets.

presets.label: eBay Store logo
presets.notes: 300 x 300. Displayed small (view width estimate).

presets.label: eBay Store marketing banner 1:1
presets.notes: 640 x 640 marketing banner on the Store page. View width estimate.

presets.label: Google Merchant Center product image
presets.background_rule: Solid white or transparent background recommended; product fills 75% to 90% of the image; no promotional overlays (price, CTA, free shipping, condition), watermarks, logos not on the product, barcodes, borders or placeholders.
presets.notes: Recommended about 1500x1500; 500x500 becomes the minimum for all products from 31 Jan 2027 (Google). Max 64 MP and 16 MB. Safe = the 90% fill boundary; the product should be at least 1125 px (75%). Up to 10 additional images; lifestyle_image_link up to 5 at 600x600 or more. Automatic image improvements can strip overlays, otherwise such images are disapproved. Apparel shown on a person. Google warns that light-coloured products on a transparent background may display on black, and says staged or lifestyle images that clearly show the product are also acceptable.

presets.label: Meta catalogue product image 1:1 (Facebook/Instagram shops and catalogue ads)
presets.background_rule: White backdrop recommended; no text over the product, calls to action, promo codes, watermarks or time-sensitive prices.
presets.notes: Shops show products 1:1; at least 500x500, 1024x1024 recommended; JPEG preferred over PNG. Up to 20 additional images; 4 or more recommended. Keep every catalogue image the same ratio (1:1 or 4:5) or carousel cards are auto-adjusted. A changed image needs a new URL. View width is an estimate for a shop grid tile.

presets.label: Shopify Dawn image banner / slideshow slide
presets.background_rule: Shopify: slideshow and background images should not contain text; put headings and buttons in the theme editor so they stay live.
presets.notes: Derived from Dawn's code: srcset widths go up to 3840; fixed heights are 420/560/720 px (small/medium/large) at 750 px and wider, 280/340/390 px on phones (1 rem = 10 px). 3840x1440 = a 1920 px screen at 2x with the large height. A phone shows only about the centre 1440x1440 (safe sides 1200 px); very wide screens crop about 180 px top and bottom. view_width_px 1040 = the whole canvas at phone scale. Choose 'Adapt to first image' to stop cropping; set a focal point (Dawn 7+). Theme images: 20 MP and 20 MB caps.

presets.label: Shopify collection image (Dawn banner + collection card)
presets.background_rule: Subject centred in the middle band; no baked-in collection name (Dawn prints the title as live text).
presets.notes: One image serves two crops: the Dawn collection banner (half the page width on desktop, full width x 200 px on phones, about 2:1, object-fit cover) and square or portrait collection cards. A square master with the subject in the middle half-height band survives both (safe top/bottom 512). Derived from Dawn CSS, not a Shopify-published size.

presets.label: Shopify product image 4:5 (Dawn portrait cards)
presets.background_rule: Same background and crop for every featured image so collection grids line up.
presets.notes: Dawn's product grid offers adapt (default), portrait (0.8 = 4:5) or square cards. Portrait suits fashion. 2048 wide follows Shopify's 2048 guidance (5.2 MP, under the 25 MP cap). On a 390 px phone a card is about 178 CSS px wide (Dawn sizes attribute). Safe margins are practice.

presets.label: WooCommerce product image 1:1
presets.background_rule: Consistent background across the catalogue; the shop grid crops thumbnails square by default.
presets.notes: WooCommerce: upload at least 800x800. Defaults: single image 600 px wide uncropped, catalogue thumbnail 300 px square-cropped (Customizer: 1:1, custom or uncropped), gallery thumbnail 100x100. 1600 = 2x the stated minimum for hover zoom (practice). Themes may override sizes.

presets.label: Etsy shop logo (shop icon)
presets.background_rule: Opaque background (Etsy renders transparent parts black). Simple mark, short text, no busy background.
presets.notes: Recommended 500x500. Etsy: not having a logo may impact search visibility. The 1 MB value is Etsy's warning that larger files may not finish uploading, not a hard cap. View width is an estimate.

presets.label: Etsy mini shop banner
presets.background_rule: Opaque; sRGB.
presets.notes: Recommended 1600x213, minimum 1200x160. Big banner is the existing etsy-banner (1600x400, min 1200x300). Mobile crop not documented: centre the message.

presets.label: Etsy Plus carousel banner
presets.notes: Carousel and collage banners need an Etsy Plus subscription. Collage banner minimums: 600x300 (2 images), 400x300 (3), 300x300 (4).

presets.label: Etsy order receipt banner
presets.notes: 760x100 is Etsy's minimum; render --scale 2 (1520x200) keeps the 7.6:1 ratio.

presets.label: TikTok Shop product image 1:1
presets.background_rule: Main image: front view on pure white. All images: no added logos, text, borders, watermarks, graphics or promo stickers; colour only; no placeholders or renders; only what the buyer receives.
presets.notes: Up to 9 square images. Minimum 600x600 in the US policy and 800x800 in the UK best-practice page (min_size uses the stricter UK figure); 5 or more images recommended. The UK page allows the product's own branding or logos but no other text or watermarks. 1200 is a practice render size that clears both minimums. Beauty guide: product about 80% or more of the frame (safe). The US policy bans added text on every product image, stricter than most marketplaces. One product video, 5 MB max.

presets.label: TikTok Shop header background (Shop Design)
presets.background_rule: High-quality brand image; the system hides blurry headers. Logo is uploaded separately as PNG/WEBP on a transparent background.
presets.notes: Recommended 780x720, max 2 MB. The header also appears in the middle of product detail pages. Safe margins are practice; logo position over the header is not documented.

presets.label: Myntra fashion image 3:4
presets.background_rule: Not verified (partner portal is login-only). Observed: studio model shots on plain light backgrounds.
presets.notes: Three of three sampled originals were 1080x1440 (3:4); desktop grid tiles render at 210x280 CSS px. Official Myntra partner specs could not be read.

presets.label: App Store screenshot iPhone 6.9-inch (portrait)
presets.background_rule: No alpha or transparency. Show the app in use (not only title art, login or splash); overlays and captions allowed; no prices; no other platforms' names or devices.
presets.notes: Accepted 6.9-inch sizes: 1260x2736, 1290x2796, 1320x2868 (portrait; landscape swapped). Supply 6.9-inch or 6.5-inch; smaller iPhones get scaled copies. 1 to 10 screenshots. The first one to three show in search results when there is no app preview: make them readable as thumbnails about a third of the phone width (estimate about 115 CSS px). view_width_px 230 is the product-page view (estimate). Safe margins are practice.

presets.label: App Store screenshot iPhone 6.5-inch (portrait)
presets.background_rule: No alpha or transparency; app-in-use content.
presets.notes: Accepted: 1284x2778 or 1242x2688. Required only if 6.9-inch screenshots are not provided.

presets.label: App Store screenshot iPhone 6.9-inch (landscape, games)
presets.background_rule: No alpha; app-in-use content.
presets.notes: Landscape variants of the 6.9-inch sizes. In search results a landscape asset takes the whole media row, so only the first shows.

presets.label: App Store screenshot iPad 13-inch (portrait)
presets.background_rule: No alpha; app-in-use content.
presets.notes: Accepted: 2064x2752 or 2048x2732 (landscape swapped). Required if the app runs on iPad. View width estimate.

presets.label: App Store app preview poster frame (iPhone 6.9/6.5-inch portrait)
presets.background_rule: Screen captures of the app only (2.3.4); narration and text overlays allowed.
presets.notes: App previews: 886x1920 portrait or 1920x886 landscape for 6.9/6.5-inch; iPad 13-inch 1200x1600; 15 to 30 s, 500 MB, up to 3. They autoplay muted; the poster frame (default at 5 s) shows when they do not. A portrait preview takes the first gallery slot.

presets.label: App Store in-app event card 16:9
presets.background_rule: Avoid text and logos, especially the event or app name; no borders or gradients (Apple adds crops and gradients).
presets.notes: 16:9, 1920x1080 to 3840x2160. Event name 30, short description 50, long description 120 characters (live text). Preview the crop in App Store Connect. View width estimate.

presets.label: App Store in-app event details image 9:16
presets.background_rule: Avoid text and logos; no borders or gradients.
presets.notes: 9:16, 1080x1920 to 2160x3840. Apple overlays the event name and description on the lower part: bottom safe margin is practice.

presets.label: Mac App Store screenshot 16:10
presets.background_rule: No alpha; app-in-use content.
presets.notes: Accepted: 1280x800, 1440x900, 2560x1600, 2880x1800 (16:10). Required for Mac apps. View width estimate.

presets.label: Google Play feature graphic 1024x500
presets.background_rule: JPEG or 24-bit PNG without alpha. Vibrant colours; avoid pure white, black or dark grey. No 'Best', '#1', 'Top', 'New', 'Free', 'Discount', 'Sale', 'Million Downloads', rankings, awards, testimonials, prices or calls to action; no device imagery; no store badges.
presets.notes: Exactly 1024x500. Safe = Google's cutoff zones measured from its own diagram (15% of each side; web.json has the same id with 5% heuristic insets, this measured safe box should win in a merge). It is the cover of the preview video: when the video does not autoplay a play button sits on top (size not documented). Do not repeat the icon as big branding. Alt text up to 140 characters.

presets.label: Google Play phone screenshot 9:16
presets.background_rule: JPEG or 24-bit PNG, no alpha. Taglines at most 20% of the image; show real UI (prioritise UI in the first three); no fingers or hands, clean status bar. No 'Best', '#1', 'Top', 'New', 'Free', 'Discount', 'Sale', 'Million Downloads', rankings, awards, testimonials, prices or calls to action; no device imagery; no store badges.
presets.notes: 2 to 8 per device type; sides 320 to 3840 px; long side at most 2x the short side. To be eligible for recommendation formats apps need at least 4 screenshots at 1080 px or more (1080x1920 portrait or 1920x1080 landscape); games at least 3. File size for phone screenshots is not stated (8 MB is stated only for Android XR). View width estimate.

presets.label: Google Play phone screenshot 16:9 (games)
presets.background_rule: Real gameplay; taglines at most 20% of the image. No 'Best', '#1', 'Top', 'New', 'Free', 'Discount', 'Sale', 'Million Downloads', rankings, awards, testimonials, prices or calls to action; no device imagery; no store badges.
presets.notes: Games need at least three 16:9 landscape (1920x1080 or more) or three 9:16 portrait screenshots to appear in recommendation formats. View width estimate.

presets.label: Google Play tablet / Chromebook screenshot 16:9
presets.background_rule: Exclude text that is not part of the app experience (it can be cut off on Play homepages).
presets.notes: Tablets (7 and 10-inch) and Chromebooks: at least 4 screenshots, 1,080 to 7,680 px, 16:9 landscape or 9:16 portrait (1080x1920).

presets.label: Google Play Android TV banner
presets.background_rule: JPEG or 24-bit PNG, no alpha. Treat it like the app's icon on TV.
presets.notes: Required for Android TV apps; only shown on TV. View width estimate.

presets.label: Google Play Android XR screenshot 8:5
presets.notes: 4 to 8 screenshots, 8:5, 3840x2400 recommended (minimum 1920x1200), 8 MB each.

presets.label: Google Play Wear OS screenshot 1:1
presets.background_rule: App interface only: no device frames, extra text, graphics, backgrounds, transparency or masking.
presets.notes: 1:1, at least 384x384; render at a larger square if the capture allows.

presets.label: Microsoft Store desktop screenshot 16:9
presets.background_rule: No extra logos, icons or marketing messages; avoid very light or dark colours and high-contrast stripes that fight caption overlays.
presets.notes: Desktop: 1366x768 or larger, 4K (3840x2160) supported; up to 10 desktop screenshots, 1 required, 4 or more suggested; caption 200 characters. Keepout = bottom third where Store text overlays may appear. View width estimate.

presets.label: Microsoft Store 2:3 poster art
presets.background_rule: May include the title (4.5:1 contrast); nothing important in the bottom third. Xbox: title required, in the top two-thirds.
presets.notes: 720x1080 or 1440x2160. Main logo image for games; may be used in search results. View width estimate.

presets.label: Microsoft Store 1:1 box art
presets.background_rule: Nothing important in the bottom third.
presets.notes: 1080x1080 or 2160x2160 (games). Apps use the 300x300 app tile icon instead.

presets.label: Microsoft Store 16:9 super hero art
presets.background_rule: No title or other text; no app UI or device imagery; centre the key detail (layouts crop); nothing key in the bottom third (gradient); minimise empty space; no flags, religious symbols, gambling, alcohol, weapons pointed at the viewer.
presets.notes: 1920x1080 or 3840x2160 PNG. Required for games with trailers; top of the listing. Side safe margins are practice. View width estimate.

presets.label: Microsoft Store 1:1 app tile icon
presets.notes: 300x300; overrides the icon from the app package on Store pages.

presets.label: Chrome Web Store extension icon 128
presets.background_rule: 96x96 artwork plus 16 px transparent padding; front-facing; works on light and dark; no edge; small shadows only.
presets.notes: Circles about 112 px wide; squarish art 75 to 80% of the width. A PNG with no alpha gets a frame with 12 px rounded corners.

presets.label: Chrome Web Store screenshot 16:10
presets.background_rule: Square corners, no padding (full bleed); show the real extension.
presets.notes: 1280x800 or 640x400; 1 to 5. All screenshots are downscaled to 640x400 on the store, so text must survive half size.

presets.label: Chrome Web Store small promo tile
presets.background_rule: Avoid text; must work at half size; assume a light grey page; saturated colours; avoid lots of white or light grey; fill the whole tile; well-defined edges.
presets.notes: Required. Items without it are listed after items that have one. Promo images are not locale-specific.

presets.label: Chrome Web Store marquee promo
presets.background_rule: Same rules as the small tile: brand-led, little or no text, saturated, full bleed.
presets.notes: Optional; needed to be featured in the marquee.

presets.label: Product Hunt thumbnail
presets.background_rule: Square; a GIF only animates on hover; no strobing, quick cuts or unreadable text.
presets.notes: 240x240 recommended; GIF under 3 MB. Live page is behind a bot check; read from the Wayback Machine. GIF is explicitly allowed; other formats are not listed.

presets.label: Product Hunt gallery image
presets.notes: 1270x760 recommended; the gallery needs 2 or more images; YouTube links for video.

presets.label: Steam header capsule
presets.background_rule: Base capsules: game art, game name and official subtitle only. No review scores, awards, discount copy, other products or other text; update or event text only through an Artwork Override (max one month, localised).
presets.notes: Top of the store page, Recommended For You, Big Picture and Daily Deals. Smaller versions are generated. Logo must stay legible. View width estimate.

presets.label: Steam small capsule
presets.background_rule: Base capsules: game art, game name and official subtitle only. No review scores, awards, discount copy, other products or other text; update or event text only through an Artwork Override (max one month, localised).
presets.notes: Used in search results and lists; 120x45 and 184x69 are generated from it, so the logo should nearly fill the capsule (view_width_px = the 120 px version).

presets.label: Steam main capsule
presets.background_rule: Base capsules: game art, game name and official subtitle only. No review scores, awards, discount copy, other products or other text; update or event text only through an Artwork Override (max one month, localised).
presets.notes: Top of the Steam home page carousel. View width estimate.

presets.label: Steam vertical capsule
presets.background_rule: Base capsules: game art, game name and official subtitle only. No review scores, awards, discount copy, other products or other text; update or event text only through an Artwork Override (max one month, localised).
presets.notes: Seasonal sale pages and the top of the front page during sales. View width estimate.

presets.label: Steam store screenshot 16:9
presets.background_rule: Gameplay only: no concept art, pre-rendered stills, awards, marketing copy or written descriptions.
presets.notes: At least 5 required; mark at least 4 as suitable for all ages or they may not show on some surfaces.

presets.label: Steam store page background
presets.background_rule: Ambient; must not compete with page content (Steam applies a template).
presets.notes: Optional; if missing Steam builds one from the last screenshot.

presets.label: Steam library capsule 2:3
presets.background_rule: Key art plus the game logo (subtitle allowed); no other text.
presets.notes: A 300x450 half-size copy is generated. View width estimate.

presets.label: Steam library header
presets.background_rule: Branding with a legible logo; no quotes or other text.
presets.notes: Recent Games and other library spots; falls back to the store header capsule.

presets.label: Steam library hero
presets.background_rule: Artwork only: no words at all (the logo is a separate layer).
presets.notes: Valve: a centred 'safe area' of 860 x 380 px stays uncropped at every window size; art should still fill the whole template. Valve does not say whether that is on the 3840 template or the 1920 half size; the safe box here uses the stricter reading. The logo is layered on top at bottom-left or centred (chosen later), so keep that zone calm.

presets.label: Steam library logo (transparent)
presets.background_rule: Transparent PNG with only the logotype and optional logomark; no other words.
presets.notes: Must be 1280 px wide and/or 720 px tall at its own aspect ratio (1280x720 here is the bounding box). Positions: bottom-left, top-centre, centre or bottom-centre over the hero.

presets.label: Steam event / announcement cover
presets.background_rule: Event art and branding; Steam adds the game name and icon next to it.
presets.notes: Required. Shown in lists of events, the store page and the library. View width estimate.

presets.label: Steam event header
presets.notes: Suggested; top of the event page (Valve's template has placement notes). Event body images display at most 800 px wide.

presets.label: Gumroad product cover 16:9
presets.notes: At least 1280x720 at 72 DPI; under 50 MB; up to 8 covers; images over 4096 px are resized (GIFs are not). Covers show at their own shape (tall ones capped at 80% of the window), so keep all covers the same shape. Put a still image first: carousel dots hide while a video plays. Gumroad claims good covers double conversion (vendor claim).

presets.label: Gumroad product thumbnail 1:1
presets.notes: At least 600x600; shown in customers' libraries, Gumroad Discover and the profile. View width estimate.

presets.label: Lemon Squeezy product image 4:3
presets.background_rule: Marketplace: visuals over text-heavy images; thumbnails must reflect the product.
presets.notes: Up to 10 images, up to 10 MB, 4:3 (official ratio; 1600x1200 is a practice size). Marketplace listings require 4:3 and ideally 6 or more images.

presets.label: Patreon creator page cover 4:1
presets.notes: At least 1600x400 (shown at most 1600x400). Patreon: keep key visuals centred, narrower screens crop the sides (amount not documented; side safe is practice).

presets.label: Patreon tier image
presets.notes: 460x200 (2.3:1) recommended. View width estimate.

presets.label: Patreon post image 16:9
presets.notes: The post feed displays 16:9; other ratios are letterboxed. Profile 1024x1024; video thumbnail 1280x720; digital product image 984x554.

presets.label: Ko-fi page cover 3:1
presets.notes: 3:1, ideally 1200x400, under 8 MB, static only. Sides may crop on mobile; keep text off the edges (side safe is practice).

presets.label: Ko-fi shop preview image 1:1
presets.notes: Up to 20 preview images; 1:1 or 2:1 (examples 600x600 or 600x300); render --scale 2 for sharper previews.

presets.label: Kickstarter project image 16:9
presets.background_rule: Show what backers will get; avoid banners, badges and extra text; use negative space.
presets.notes: 1024x576 recommended, max 50 MB; also the share image on social. Live page is behind a bot check. Project video displays at 640x360; a vertical 9:16 'Discovery Mode' video is supported.

presets.label: Udemy course image 16:9
presets.background_rule: No course title or other text (logo only, inside the safe area, not over the photo); no frames, borders, strokes or letterboxing; unique image per course; one focal point.
presets.notes: Minimum 750x422, maximum 6000x6000; 1500x844 = 2x (practice). The Udemy app crops every course image: the safe area in Udemy's diagram is the centre square (measured, about 56% of the width), so sides of 328 px at this size. Course image problems are one of the most common reasons a course is rejected in quality review.

presets.label: Teachable product thumbnail 16:9
presets.notes: Recommended 1024x576; school thumbnail 960x540; images must be smaller than 11,520x6,480. Ratio matters more than exact px.

presets.label: Teachable page banner block 3:1
presets.background_rule: Pages are responsive: keep headings as live text.
presets.notes: 1800x600 or 1500x800. Side safe margins are practice.

presets.label: Thinkific course card image
presets.notes: Recommended 760x420 for course, bundle, membership and community cards; max 4 MB.

presets.label: Thinkific banner 2:1
presets.background_rule: Graphic or abstract image without text: banners crop top and bottom on wide screens and the sides on phones.
presets.notes: Homepage and course landing banners 1440x720 (about 1 MB). Side safe is practice.

presets.label: Skillshare class cover 16:9
presets.background_rule: Avoid text and icons; nothing important near the edges or in the upper-left corner (Staff Pick badge).
presets.notes: Crop to 1280x720 to avoid cropping or stretching. Badge size not documented.

presets.label: Eventbrite event image 2:1
presets.background_rule: You must own the image or have permission.
presets.notes: At least 2160x1080 recommended, 2:1, JPEG or PNG, 10 MB max. Eventbrite uses your focus point to make a SQUARE thumbnail for search results: keep the title and subject inside the centre 1080x1080 (safe) or set the focus point on it. The first image is the cover; video optional.

presets.label: Meetup group cover / event featured photo 16:9
presets.notes: Group cover: 16:9, 1200x675 ideal and minimum, under 10 MB, JPG/PNG/non-animated GIF. Event featured photo has no stated size (falls back to the group photo); same 16:9 is the safe choice.

presets.label: Luma event cover 1:1
presets.background_rule: Little text (unreadable in small preview cards); static images preferred over GIFs.
presets.notes: Square 1:1; at least 800x800 recommended (1600 = 2x, practice). A square, high-quality cover is required for featuring. Luma builds the Open Graph share image from the cover and event name.

presets.label: Daraz product image 1:1
presets.background_rule: White background, product centred and large; no text of any kind (price, phone or WhatsApp numbers, links), no watermarks, borders, collages or frames; modest presentation (mannequin or flat lay for intimate apparel); own photos, not web images.
presets.notes: Daraz publishes its rules (no text, modesty policy, at least 4 angles, no duplicate or web-sourced images) but not its pixel limits, so the size comes from Lazada, whose seller platform Daraz uses. Lazada: 330x330 to 5000x5000, up to 8 images, 1:1 and white recommended, 1000x1000 recommended for promotion images; API file cap 3 MB in one document and 1 MB in another (the conservative 1 MB is used here). Measured on daraz.com.bd (375 px phone): search tile 174 CSS px, product image 375x375 CSS px served at 720x720. Label 'practice' because the Daraz-specific numbers are a proxy.

presets.label: Lazada product image 1:1
presets.platform: Lazada (SG, MY, PH, ID, TH, VN)
presets.background_rule: White recommended (a 1:1 white image may boost homepage visibility); promotion images pure white or transparent; no watermarks, borders or marketing copy.
presets.notes: Range 330x330 to 5000x5000 (2019 guide: 300 to 5000, 500x500 and 1:1 recommended); up to 8 images, 3 or more recommended. Promotion square image 1000x1000 recommended. Image quality score drops for frames, collages, off-centre products, low resolution or text-only images. File cap conflict: 3 MB vs 1 MB in Lazada's own API docs.

presets.label: Lazada promotion long image 3:4
presets.background_rule: White preferred or a real setting; no watermarks, borders or marketing copy.
presets.notes: Minimum and recommended 750x1000; one image; a wrong ratio is dropped silently. Older Lazada material calls it '4:3', but the 2023 screenshot shows a 3:4 portrait.

presets.label: Lazada / Daraz store header (app)
presets.platform: Lazada Store Builder (Daraz uses the same seller platform)
presets.source: https://university.lazada.sg (courses 'Decorate Your Lazada Marketplace Store' 2025-11-03 and 'Decorate Your LazMall Store' 2026-03-11)
presets.notes: APP 750x478 in Lazada's 2025 and 2026 courses; a 2021 LazMall PDF said 750x180 (older). Daraz's own Store Decoration sizes could not be read; this is the Lazada figure. Store logo 600x600.

presets.label: Lazada / Daraz store header (desktop)
presets.source: https://university.lazada.sg (courses 'Decorate Your Lazada Marketplace Store' 2025-11-03 and 'Decorate Your LazMall Store' 2026-03-11)
presets.notes: PC header 1200x128. Single banners are 1200 wide by 50 to 2000 px high (max 1 MB, up to 32); carousels up to 6 images at 1200 or 1920 wide; 3-image banners 600x300; 4 and 5-image banners 291x291.

presets.label: Lazada / Daraz store single banner
presets.source: https://university.lazada.sg (courses 'Decorate Your Lazada Marketplace Store' 2025-11-03 and 'Decorate Your LazMall Store' 2026-03-11)
presets.notes: Width 1200 fixed; height anywhere from 50 to 2000 px (600 chosen here, practice). Max 1 MB each. Carousels also accept 1920 wide.

presets.label: Shopee product cover image 1:1
presets.platform: Shopee (SG, MY, PH, ID, TH, VN, TW, BR)
presets.background_rule: Cover: product at least 70% of the image, preferably on white, avoid text and graphics. Quality score: background at least 10% (product at most 90%), no white borders, text, graphics and watermarks at most 25% of the background and never over the product; no contact details, links or photos taken from other platforms.
presets.source: Shopee Seller Education Hub articles PH 284, SG 17318, SG 27838 (2026-07-06), PH 24949 (2026-05-25), SG 7081 (2026-08-27) (seller.shopee.{tld}; readable via /help/api/v3/article/detail/?article_id=ID)
presets.notes: Up to 9 images including the cover (Taiwan 9 or 12); minimum 500x500 at 72 dpi; 1:1 mandatory, 3:4 optional. 1000 = 2x the minimum (practice). Seller Centre upload cap 2 MB (the API allows 10 MB). Safe = the 70% cover fill. Shopee overlays badges: Mall or Preferred at top-left, discount at top-right, a campaign strip along the bottom and a Sponsored tag at bottom-right (Vietnam example). Mall covers have per-country rules (logo top-left at most 10% in SG; text at most 20% in TW).

presets.label: Shopee product image 3:4 (optional, fashion)
presets.background_rule: The image must fill the whole 3:4 area (it is auto-cropped).
presets.source: Shopee Seller Education Hub articles PH 17355 and TW 17316
presets.notes: Optional next to the mandatory 1:1 images. Shopee warns a 3:4 image may not suit listings that will use campaign frames. The pixel size is not published; 1125x1500 is practice (3:4 at 1.5x the 1:1 width).

presets.label: Shopee shop cover image
presets.background_rule: No other marketplaces, personal contacts (phone, WhatsApp, address, social links) or Shopee's own logo.
presets.source: Shopee Seller Education Hub articles SG 7013 and MY 1928 (same limits in ID 6918 and TW 594)
presets.notes: 1200x675, 2 MB, JPG/JPEG/PNG.

presets.label: Shopee shop decoration carousel 2:1
presets.background_rule: Same content bans as the shop cover.
presets.source: Shopee Seller Education Hub articles SG 7013, MY 1928 and SG 17821
presets.notes: Carousel ratios: 2:1 (2000x1000), 16:9 (2000x1125), 1:1 (2000x2000) or free, up to 6 images of the same ratio, max 2000x2000. Single image and banner components are 1200 wide (100 to 2200 px high; banner and category 100 to 900); campaign page 1200x600; all 2 MB. Side safe margins are practice.

presets.label: Tokopedia product image 1:1
presets.background_rule: Plain or white background; no watermark, collage or heavy text. Official Store main image: white, whole product about 70%, text no more than 30%, no model.
presets.notes: Archived rules: 5 photo slots, square, 300x300 minimum, 2048x2048 maximum, 700x700 'optimal'. 1400 = 2x the optimum within the maximum (practice). The live pages could not be read, so current limits are unverified (Tokopedia now runs with TikTok Shop).

presets.label: Noon product image
presets.background_rule: Primary image: front view on pure white (fashion: light grey recommended), product 70 to 80% of the frame, no lifestyle shot, packaging, tags or hard shadows. Rejected: logos, watermarks, borders, price, warranty text or expiry dates on the image.
presets.notes: JPEG only; width 660 px or more; width-to-height ratio 0.5 or more (portrait down to 1:2 allowed); 72 PPI; sRGB; 10 MB. Vertical products need 10% margin top and bottom, horizontal ones 5% each side. At least 3 images recommended, ordered front, back, side, other, details, usage. 1320 square = 2x the minimum width (practice); safe = the 80% fill boundary.

presets.label: Noon store banner 6:1
presets.source: Noon partner help centre, store logo and banner article (helpcenter.noon.partners)
presets.notes: Minimum 1440x240 (6:1); the left and right edges may be cropped on small screens (amount not stated; side safe is practice); separate English and Arabic banners, set per country. Render --scale 2 for sharpness. Store logo minimum 100x100 (1:1).

presets.label: Mercado Libre / Mercado Livre product photo 1:1
presets.platform: Mercado Libre (AR, MX, CO, CL, BR)
presets.background_rule: Pure white, digitally created background on the cover (some fashion and home categories may use a real setting); product fills 95% of the frame, centred; no watermarks, logos, QR codes, text, borders or contact details; do not imitate Mercado Libre's own labels; packaging only from the second photo.
presets.source: https://developers.mercadolibre.com.ar/es_ar/trabajar-con-imagenes ; Mercado Libre help article 805 (AR, MX, CO, CL; BR: mercadolivre.com.br/ayuda/Como-tirar-boas-fotos-dos-seus-produtos_805)
presets.notes: Upload 1200x1200; maximum 1920x1920 (larger is resized); minimum 500x500; zoom appears above 800 px wide; up to 12 photos per item and 10 per variation in general categories. Flagged covers get a poor_quality_thumbnail tag; the moderation API checks white background, size, text/logo and watermark. Safe = the 95% fill boundary.

presets.label: Mercado Libre fashion photo (vertical)
presets.background_rule: Textured or light neutral plain background allowed; model or invisible mannequin.
presets.source: Mercado Libre Argentina help articles 21874 (tops) and 22501 (dresses)
presets.notes: Ideal 1200x1540, 72 dpi, RGB; 4 to 10 photos (Argentina help for tops and dresses).

presets.label: Allegro gallery image
presets.background_rule: Any background colour; no store text or store logo. Brand, technology and certificate logos, numbers and dimension graphics are allowed; infographics only for invited sellers and never as the thumbnail.
presets.notes: Longer side at least 500 px; up to 2560x2560 (larger is scaled down) and 26 MP; any proportions; sRGB. 10 images (regular account), 16 (business), 40 (classifieds). 2560 = the largest size kept unscaled (practice); no white-first-image rule was found.

presets.label: E-book cover, cross-platform master
presets.notes: One file that passes every verified store rule: KDP ideal 1600x2560 (1.6:1), Apple shortest side at least 1400 px, Google Play min 640 px and max 7200 px, B&N Press at least 1400 px and 2 MB or less, Kobo JPG 5 MB or less and portrait, D2D any tall rectangle. Save as sRGB JPEG under 2 MB, no border. The size is a derived choice, not one platform's number. Rokomari (Bangladesh) publishes no e-book cover spec; Boitoi only asks for a JPG or PNG cover. Legibility check: the title must read when the cover is 218 px tall (Amazon desktop search at 1x) and 135 to 160 px tall (recommendation strips). Keep the title in the top half, few words, high contrast. No price, 'free', store names or 3D mockups (Apple and KDP reject them). safe zone not published: 5 % of the short side. Seen about 300 px wide on the product page; listed about 94 to 136 px wide in search results and recommendation strips, where the title and the author must still read (the judge shows that size).

presets.label: Kindle e-book cover (Amazon KDP)
presets.notes: Ideal 1600 x 2560 px, height to width at least 1.6:1. Minimum 625 x 1000 px, maximum 10000 px per side; 2500 px tall recommended for HD screens; covers under 500 px on the shortest side are not shown. JPEG (TIFF also accepted), RGB only. The two KDP pages disagree on file size (50 MB vs 5 MB): stay under 5 MB. For white or very light covers add a 3 to 4 px medium grey border (KDP only; Apple forbids unnecessary borders). No price, promotions, typos or placeholder text; title and author must match the detail page. safe zone not published: 5 % of the short side. Seen about 300 px wide on the product page; listed about 94 to 136 px wide in search results and recommendation strips, where the title and the author must still read (the judge shows that size).

presets.label: E-book cover (Draft2Digital and Smashwords)
presets.notes: D2D asks for a JPEG around 1600 x 2400 (1.5:1) and accepts any tall rectangle, resizing per store. Must show title and author. Smashwords authors publish through D2D since January 2026, so these rules apply there too. Rejected: covers that mimic popular titles, unprofessional images. safe zone not published: 5 % of the short side. Seen about 300 px wide on the product page; listed about 94 to 136 px wide in search results and recommendation strips, where the title and the author must still read (the judge shows that size).

presets.label: E-book cover (BookBaby)

Fixed-layout e-books: height 1500 to under 3000 px, shape matches the book. safe zone not published: 5 % of the short side. Seen about 300 px wide on the product page; listed about 94 to 136 px wide in search results and recommendation strips, where the title and the author must still read (the judge shows that size).

presets.label: E-book cover (Kobo Writing Life, 3:4)
presets.notes: Kobo's official rule is a ratio, not a pixel size: width three quarters of height (3:4), portrait, JPG best (PNG ok), 5 MB or less, 300 dpi best, title and author on the cover, no 3D box-set images. 1800 x 2400 px is a chosen size that meets the ratio; the often-quoted 1600 x 2400 for Kobo was seen only in search summaries. The 1600 x 2560 master is also accepted by Kobo. safe zone not published: 5 % of the short side. Seen about 300 px wide on the product page; listed about 94 to 136 px wide in search results and recommendation strips, where the title and the author must still read (the judge shows that size).

In Bangladesh certificates print on A4 certificate paper at 150 to 160 gsm or metallic card at 250 to 300 gsm (Daraz listings).
